title: Head of Customer Success (w/d/m)
description: Für unsere Jobs gibt es keine Bewerbungsfristen. Solange der Job angezeigt wird, kannst du dich bewerben. Wir brauchen kein Anschreiben, nur deinen Lebenslauf oder XING-/LinkedIn-Profil.  Deine Aufgaben    Du baust die Customer-Success (CS)-Funktion bei Diamant von Grund auf auf: Coverage-Logik, Kund:innensegmentierung sowie Playbooks für Onboarding, Adoption, QBR und Renewal, inklusive operativem Rollout im Team.  Du rekrutierst ein Team aus CS-Manager:innen und entwickelst es weiter, mit Fokus auf Skill-Aufbau, KPI-Ownership und einer Kultur, die Kund:innennähe und unternehmerisches Denken verbindet.  Du implementierst ein Health-Score-Modell aus Produktnutzungsdaten, Supporthistorie und Engagement-Signalen, das Churn-Risiken früh erkennt und Wachstumssignale sichtbar macht.  Du verantwortest die zentralen CS-Kennzahlen wie GRR, NRR, Adoption Rate, Health Score, Renewal Rate sowie CSAT/NPS und leitest daraus Maßnahmen zur nachhaltigen Kund:innenentwicklung ab.  Du sorgst gemeinsam mit Consulting und Support für saubere Übergaben entlang der Customer Journey vom Onboarding bis in die laufende Betreuung und bist Sparringspartner für Sales bei Renewals und Upsells.  Du treibst KI-gestützte CS-Prozesse voran, von automatisierten Touchpoints über Health Monitoring bis zum Onboarding und bist die Stimme des Kunden im Unternehmen, indem du strukturiertes Produktfeedback aus dem Feld in die Produktorganisation trägst.    Dein Profil    Du bringst mehrere Jahre Führungserfahrung im CS oder Post-Sales-Umfeld eines B2B-SaaS- oder Softwareunternehmens mit und hast bereits nachweislich eine CS-Funktion aufgebaut.  Du arbeitest datengetrieben, erkennst Zusammenhänge in CS-Daten und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen zur Steigerung von Nutzung, Kund:innenzufriedenheit und -bindung ab.  Du hast Playbooks, Kund:innensegmentierungen und Coverage-Modelle entwickelt und verfügst über Erfahrung mit CRM- und CS-Tools sowie idealerweise mit Finance-, ERP- oder Accounting-Software.  Du verstehst die wirtschaftlichen Hebel von Revenue, Retention und Marge und arbeitest dabei eng und auf Augenhöhe mit Sales und Product zusammen, etwa bei Renewal-Gesprächen oder der Priorisierung von Produktfeedback.  Du hast Builder-Mentalität, baust Strukturen und Prozesse erfolgreich auf und nutzt KI gezielt, um Betreuung und Onboarding skalierbar zu machen.  Du kommunizierst klar und direkt auf allen Ebenen, von Kund:innen auf C-Level bis zum eigenen Team, und sprichst fließend Deutsch sowie sicher Englisch.    Diese Benefits warten auf dich ...  Gemeinsam Lösungen finden  Werde Teil eines Experten-Teams, das Kundenzufriedenheit großschreibt und Erfolge gemeinsam feiert.  Individuelle Förderung  Praxisnahe Schulungen und Weiterbildungen, die dich fit für alle Herausforderungen machen.  Flexibilität im Alltag  Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, mobil zu arbeiten.  Kundenfokus statt Stress  Strukturierte Prozesse und moderne Tools erleichtern deine tägliche Arbeit.

title: Head of Operations
description: Head of Operations      Kandidaatprofiel   Vanaf 8 jaar werkervaring  In een SaaS- of technologieomgeving  Heeft consultancy-, implementatie- of supportteams aangestuurd  Stuurt op KPI’s  Heeft werkprocessen gestandaardiseerd en ingevoerd  Houdt grip op marge en resultaat       Met één platform voor webshop, voorraad, orderverwerking en boekhouding laten handelsbedrijven meer dan duizend webshops draaien op Logic4. Sinds vorig jaar hoort het bedrijf bij softwaregroep Katapull, de buy-and-build van investeerder Nedvest. De Head of Operations maakt de dienstverlening rond implementatie en support voorspelbaar, schaalbaar en rendabel.       Over Logic4   Logic4 ontwikkelt sinds 2003 alles-in-één software waarmee handelsbedrijven hun volledige bedrijfsvoering organiseren. Webshop, artikelbeheer, voorraad, inkoop, orderverwerking, logistiek en boekhouding werken naadloos samen, van eerste bestelling tot factuur, voor zowel B2B als B2C. Die aanpak leverde het bedrijf twee FD Gazelle-noteringen en een plek in de Emerce100 op.     In 2025 bundelde investeerder Nedvest het bedrijf met vier andere softwarespecialisten voor handelsbedrijven in Katapull. Inmiddels telt de groep zeven labels, waaronder kassasoftwarebedrijf Vendit, marketplace-integrator EffectConnect en webshopbouwer Highbiza; begin 2026 sloot ook retourenplatform Returnista aan. Voor Logic4 brengt de groep schaal en kennis, en de lat gaat omhoog. Dat momentum is voelbaar. In juli 2026 verhuisde het bedrijf van Enschede naar een nieuw kantoor aan het Industrieplein in Hengelo, op een verdieping met Highbiza. Dit jaar traden bovendien een nieuwe Managing Director en een nieuwe commercieel directeur aan, met scherpe commerciële plannen en een sterkere marketingmotor als basis voor de volgende groeisprong.     De cultuur binnen Logic4 is informeel en hecht, met korte lijnen en de vrijdagmiddagborrel als vast ritueel. Die korte lijnen passen bij een team van doeners, dat achter een verbetering gaat staan zodra het effect merkbaar wordt.      “Laat je zien waar je voor staat, dan word je in dit team snel omarmd. Ik werk graag met iemand die me scherp houdt en zelf knopen doorhakt. Dit wordt samen bouwen, vanaf de eerste dag.”  Simon Plattel Managing Director Logic4      Vacature: Head of Operations   Als lid van het managementteam draagt de Head of Operations de verantwoordelijkheid voor Consultancy, Customer Solutions en Design, samen twaalf professionals die bepalen hoe klanten Logic4 dagelijks ervaren. De verbetergebieden zijn in kaart gebracht en vertaald naar (kwartaal)doelstellingen. Dat maakt de start heel concreet. De Head of Operations werkt vanaf de eerste week aan de uitvoering van de strategie, met alle ruimte voor eigen voorstellen over de aanpak.     De eerste focus ligt op de consultancyorganisatie, waar consultants en designers Logic4 bij klanten implementeren en optimaliseren. De Head of Operations zet een herkenbare implementatieaanpak neer, geeft grip op planning en capacite

title: Customer Experience Manager
description: Customer Experience Manager (Tax) – Tax Nuggets Academy | $100K–$120K Base | Fully Remote (Australia)      Watch video for more details     Stop billing your time in six-minute increments. Start owning the customer experience for a tax knowledge platform built by people who used to do your job.     Tax Nuggets Academy is a tax knowledge platform built for Australian SME accountants and tax practitioners. It’s the Netflix for tax training, and they've launched Ask Nugget, an AI tax research tool, built from the ground up that actually knows Australian tax law, not a chatbot that sounds confident, or an LLM wrapper that quietly makes things up.     The customer experience seat is all about being a trusted advisor to our customers. From developing their learning pathways to advising on AI policy and usage, you'll be their point of contact.     This starts with onboarding calls, webinars, and product queries so that our customers have a 5-star experience from the get-go.     Tax Nuggets is in hyper-growth mode, adding headcount across the customer-facing team as it scales. Whoever takes this on gets to help shape how the customer experience function works while the system around it is still being built.      Why this role    $100K–$120K base  Be part of a fast-scaling company making noise in the accounting space  No two days are the same, and the opportunities to stretch and grow your skills are endless  Fully remote, anywhere in Australia       What you'll actually do    Run live onboarding sessions across both products for practitioners.  Run learning plan consultations and quarterly learning reviews. You'll be seen as the firm's  Fractional Head of Learning , helping them shape best practices to develop their teams using Tax Nuggets as the foundation.  Host one-to-many webinars for onboarding, adoption, and best practices, so good experiences scale beyond one firm at a time.  Be the product expert. Handle the technical questions that get escalated because no one else can answer them.  Be our AI best-practice voice for accounting firms — implementation, AI policy, AI education — helping firms use Ask Nugget and AI generally without getting themselves into trouble.  Own customer experience initiatives end to end: design them, execute them, measure whether they moved anything.  Spot upsell and expansion signals during onboarding and flag them to the sales team. Closing isn't your job; identifying is.  Build sales and marketing assets from what you learn: a quarterly topic brief, best-practice material, and the learning best-practice guide for accounting firms we're working with right now.  Pick up ad hoc projects as they come up, and work with the sales leaders to build a world-class customer experience playbook. title: Retail Onboarding Team Lead - German speaking
description: About Wolt   At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.  Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.  As part of our Onboarding Operations team, the  Retail Onboarding Team Lead  plays a key role in ensuring that our Retail partners are seamlessly and efficiently onboarded onto the Wolt platform. Reporting to the Country Lead Onboarding Operations, you will lead a dynamic team focused on onboarding new Retail partners while driving continuous process improvements and collaborating cross-functionally to ensure high-quality results.  The ideal candidate has a mix of leadership, operational, and onboarding experience, combined with a proactive, problem-solving approach to lead the team to success. If you are passionate about operational excellence, love working with data, and enjoy driving cross-functional projects, this role is for you.   What You’ll Be Doing     Team Leadership: Manage a team of 8 people, ensuring the seamless onboarding of Retail partners, focusing on quality, efficiency, and adherence to regulations.  Drive Retail Onboarding: Ensure timely onboarding of Retail partners and maintain high-quality standards. Be responsible for meeting KPIs while maintaining excellent customer experiences.  Process Optimization: Continuously improve and streamline onboarding processes, particularly for large product assortments (e.g. supermarkets) and grocery partners, to increase efficiency and reduce operational bottlenecks.  Cross-Functional Projects: Collaborate with Product, Sales, Account Management and Catalog teams on projects aimed at improving the Retail onboarding process and overall operational excellence.  Retail Onboarding Advocate: Act as the main point of contact (POC) for the Retail department, representing Retail Onboarding in discussions about product changes and other key decisions.  KPI Monitoring: Set, track, and analyze KPIs to ensure optimal team performance   Data Quality Focus: Ensure data accuracy and quality, especially in relation to large product assortments in the supermarket and grocery segments, ensuring that all product information is reliable, up to date, and complete.  LMIV Expertise: Become an expert in LMIV (Lebensmittelinformationsverordnung) regulations, ensuring that all processes, particularly in grocery and supermarket onboarding, comply with these legal standards. title: STAGE Fullstack - Socle générique de mini jeux temps réel (H/F)
description:
Basés en plein cœur de Paris, nous faisons bouger l’industrie des jeux en ligne. Leader du poker et des paris sportifs en France avec 350 000 joueurs et 600 000 parieurs mensuels, nous sommes présents en Espagne, en Allemagne et bientôt en Italie et au Portugal. Nous offrons à nos joueurs une expérience exceptionnelle, à la fois technique, créative et qualitative. Innovation, unité et appartenance : nos valeurs façonnent une culture d’entreprise multiculturelle et unique.
 
Et si tu avais un futur dans le jeu ?
 
Techniquement, Winamax c’est :
  • Un moteur de jeu puissant et innovant : adaptation dynamique de l'offre de jeu, parties de poker hautement configurables, détection de fraude
  • Une architecture distribuée et scalable conçue pour traiter en temps réel les flux de la plateforme
  • Une plateforme modulaire soumise à des contraintes de haute disponibilité et de sécurisation des données, capable de gérer de fortes audience

Contexte
Nos mini-jeux reposent sur la même logique de fond : une session courte, une animation qui doit rester fluide du début à la fin, un résultat traçable et auditable par le régulateur. Chaque nouveau mini jeu repart pourtant de zéro, alors que l'essentiel est commun.
 
Comment concevoir un socle générique qui permette d'en sortir un nouveau en quelques semaines, sans rien céder ni sur la fluidité ni sur l'auditabilité ?

Objectifs du stage
  • Concevoir le template générique et les API associées : cycle de vie d'une session, actions du joueur, résultats
  • Développer le socle d'interface à partir des maquettes UX/UI : L'enjeu visue

title: Deputy Head of Financial Crime
description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We’re looking for a Deputy Head of Financial Crime to join our financial Crime Operations team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help safeguard the firm against financial crime risks, lead critical remediation initiatives, and drive control enhancements as part of our Financial Crime Operations team as we scale our business spend management platform. If you're excited about building robust, future-proofed compliance frameworks and leading high-performing operational teams and are passionate about financial crime prevention and regulatory excellence, then this is the opportunity for you!

Dann bekommst du hier den Freiraum dafür. Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes, familiengeführtes Technologieunternehmen aus Freiburg, das Hard- und Softwarelösungen für die industrielle Bildverarbeitung und Automation entwickelt. Die eigenen Systeme kommen heute in mehr als 15.000 Maschinen weltweit zum Einsatz.

Als Systemadministrator Linux verstärkst du einen bewusst klein gehaltenen IT Bereich und bekommst entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Statt starrer Konzernstrukturen erwarten dich kurze Wege, direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung und die Möglichkeit, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten. 

Der technologische Fokus liegt konsequent auf Linux und Open Source. In den kommenden Jahren stehen spannende Themen an: bestehende Anwendungen sollen auf Open Source Alternativen migriert, Cyber Security und Resilience weiter ausgebaut und ein eigener interner Linux basierter KI Server kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden. 

Wenn Linux dein fachliches Zuhause ist und du lieber neue Lösungen entwickelst, als nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen zu halten, kannst du hier eine IT Landschaft langfristig mitprägen. 

Deine Benefits

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Entscheide aktiv mit, wie sich die interne IT in den Bereichen Linux, Open Source, Cyber Security, Resilience und Automatisierung

Air freight carries less than 1% of world trade by volume and more than a third of it by value, around $22.7 billion of goods every single day. It's how a vaccine reaches a clinic before it spoils, how a semiconductor arrives before the production line stops, and how a retailer restocks a continent away in three days instead of five weeks. Somebody has to price it, book it and move it, and that work is still done largely by hand, in inboxes and spreadsheets.

In March 2026 we launched the industry's first AI-native operating system for multimodal freight:one workspace where freight teams and AI agents work side by side across rate management, procurement, quoting, booking and support. Crane Worldwide and Yusen Logistics are rolling it out across their global operations.

AI-led engineering is how we build. Engineers write specs and acceptance criteria, agents do much of the implementation, and the engineer owns the architecture, the review and what ships.

This has brought together IMO and IOI medalists, former founders and Olympic athletes in a team whose individual strengths reinforce one another.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Cloud Partner Integrations
description:
About the team

Most providers make customers migrate their data to them. We're doing the opposite: bringing ClickHouse Cloud into the environments our customers already trust, so their data stays useful right where it lives.

Those environments come in a few shapes. Some are major cloud data platforms that run ClickHouse as a native service, so customers get it without leaving the tool they already use. Some are BI and visualization tools that need ClickHouse to show up as a fast, first-class data source behind their dashboards. And some are developer and data platforms we connect through marketplaces and identity federation with a couple of clicks to link an account. The goal is the same every time: ClickHouse should feel like a first-class citizen in every environment.

As the founding backend engineer, you'll set the technical defaults for this team. You'll have end-to-end ownership, but you'll also work inside the constraints of platforms you don't own: thin documentation, unfamiliar deployment topologies, and timelines governed by partner approval cycles. A lot of the challenge is engineering across trust boundaries you don't fully control. You won't be doing it alone. You'll work closely with the team's engineering manager and a small founding group that will grow around you, but you'll be the one setting the technical direction. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, let's talk.

What you'll do

You'll own an integration end to end: the design, the code, and the production system that keeps running after launch. You're setting the technical defaults a growing team will inherit, so the early decisions matter.

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer
description:
YOUR MISSION

 

A software engineer today uses Claude Code or Cursor. A mechanical engineer designing the next jet engine still searches Excel sheets and asks whoever has been around longest.

 

We are building the AI co-engineer for physical products: one that works natively in 3D and learns from real engineering decisions. We are in production with major European manufacturers, with real revenue and customers who tell us when we are slow.

 

The problems are open ones. Getting an agent to reason usefully about geometry, making 3D search work on real customer part libraries, and figuring out what the interface even looks like when an engineer asks why a bracket failed. There is research to borrow from and very little product to copy.

 

Senior or staff level depending on experience.

 

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 

You will own large problems end to end, across the stack. We cannot say exactly what that looks like in month three, but here is what the last two years have actually involved.

 

  • A multi-agent orchestration SDK, built from scratch. Nothing off the shelf handled what we needed: long-horizon execution that runs for hours and survives restarts.

title: Founding Legal Engineer
description:
About Grubel

Grubel is a research lab that builds AI for high-stakes knowledge work, starting with law. Legal matters require specialized expertise, and each one involves its own facts, practices, parties, and institutions. General-purpose AI applies the same system to every legal matter, varying only what goes into a limited context window.

To meet the depth and diversity of legal work, we let every matter build its own AI: engineer the right data for the matter, adapt the model and agent to it, and track what improves. We combine the three into a matter-specific improvement loop that runs until the system delivers what the matter demands.

Grubel was founded in 2026 by Moritz Hardt, director at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and formerly a UC Berkeley professor and Google Brain researcher; and Reinhard Heckel, professor of machine learning at the Technical University of Munich, on leave to build Grubel. The founding team includes engineers with PhDs in computer science and experience in foundation-model pretraining at Mistral and legal AI research at Thomson Reuters. The lab has offices in Munich and Tübingen.

Point Nine led an oversubscribed pre-seed funding round with backing from leading AI researchers and founders, including Jeff Dean, Chris Ré, Ion Stoica, and Harvey co-founders Gabe Pereyra and Winston Weinberg.

You are a skilled lawyer ideally with experience on building legal AI software eager to shape the technological future of your field. As a Founding Legal Engineer, you impact how we scope, build, and evaluate AI systems for complex legal work, and how these systems enter legal practice.

Talent Acquisition Manager (m/w/d)

Im klassischen Inhouse-Recruiting arbeitest du an den Stellen, die dir zugewiesen werden, mit dem Budget, das jemand anderes verhandelt hat. Bei uns läuft es umgekehrt: Du entscheidest, welche Unternehmen du gewinnst, wie ihre Recruiting-Strategie aussieht und über welche Kanäle die Besetzung läuft. Beratung, Umsetzung und Ergebnis liegen in einer Hand – deiner.

Aramaz Digital ist eine wachsende Recruiting-Beratung im Zentrum von Bielefeld. Wir machen Arbeitgeber sichtbar und liefern ihnen planbar passende Bewerbungen – über datengetriebene Kampagnen statt Zufallstreffer. Fachkräftemangel und demografische Entwicklung lassen diesen Markt jedes Jahr weiter wachsen.

Deine Verantwortung

Strategie und Beratung

  • Du analysierst, warum die Personalgewinnung eines Unternehmens nicht liefert – Zielgruppe, Positionierung, Kanäle, Prozessgeschwindigkeit.

  • Daraus entwickelst du eine belastbare Recruiting-Strategie und stellst sie den Entscheidern vor.

  • Du gewinnst neue Kunden aktiv: über Telefon, Direktansprache und Empfehlungen.

Kampagnen und Besetzung

  • Du planst Recruiting-Kampagnen, steuerst sie über die Laufzeit und justierst anhand der Zahlen nach.

  • Du prüfst eingehende Bewerbungen, führst Erstgespräche zur Vorauswahl und gestaltest eine Candidate Experience, die im Gedächtnis bleibt.

  • Bis zur erfolgreichen Besetzung bleibt das Projekt in deiner Hand.</

title: Senior Prototyping Engineer (f/m/d) – Thermal Systems & Cooling Integration
description:
As a Senior Prototyping Engineer – Thermal Systems & Cooling Integration, you will become an integral part of our Prototyping team, supporting the development of our Reliant platform – a next-generation long-range eVTOL unmanned aerial system designed for demanding ISR and logistics missions. Reliant combines exceptional endurance, modularity, and operational flexibility to deliver mission-critical capabilities in the most challenging environments.

In this role, you will be responsible for the integration, development, and validation of thermal management and cooling systems for the aircraft. You will develop efficient cooling concepts for hybrid propulsion components, power electronics, avionics, and other heat-generating systems by optimizing airflow, aerodynamic cooling, and thermal integration. Working closely with mechanical, propulsion, and systems engineering teams, you will ensure reliable operation across demanding flight and environmental conditions.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Lead the integration and development of thermal management and cooling systems for UAVs.

  • Design and optimize cooling concepts for combustion engines, generators, power electronics, avionics, and other onboard systems.

  • Develop aerodynamic cooling solutions, including airflow management, ducting, air inlets and outlets, heat exchangers, and passive and active cooling concepts.

  • Define thermal system architectures balancing cooling performance, weight, packaging, reliability, and manufacturability.

  • Design, build, and commission prototype cooling test rigs and instrumentation for system validation.

  • Plan and execute thermal, environmental, endurance, and performance test campaigns.

  • Analyze thermal performance, airflow distribution, and system efficiency, implementing improvements based on test results.

title: Cloud Platform Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Ab

sofort


Das erwartet dich

Wir bauen mit unserem Green-Field-Ansatz eine neue Cloud in unseren deutschen Rechenzentren auf — vollständig selbst gehostet, cloud-native und ohne Abhängigkeit von amerikanischen Hyperscalern. Jeder unserer Kunden erhält ein dediziertes Kubernetes-Cluster auf Basis des SUSE-Stacks (Harvester, RKE2), ausgerollt und verwaltet über Fleet, mit eigenem Tenant-Management.

Du bist nicht Betreiber eines fremden Systems, sondern gestaltest die Plattform, auf der unsere Software als SaaS läuft — mit echter Verantwortung und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.

Digitale Souveränität ist bei uns kein Versprechen, sondern Betriebsrealität. Auf dieser Plattform laufen die geschäftskritischen Anwendungen von Versicherern und Auftraggebern der öffentlichen Hand. Die Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Informationssicherheit und Nachweisbarkeit sind auf allerhöchsten Level. Hierfür sind unsere Managed Services nach BSI C5 testiert.

Das erwartet dich

Plattform entwickeln und gestalten

  • Konzeption, Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung der selbst gehosteten Cloud-Plattform (Multi-Cluster, ohne Hyperscaler-Abhängigkeit, volle Kontrolle)
  • Architektur und Design hochverfügbarer Kubernetes-Cluster im SUSE-Stack, inklusive Networking, Storage, Load Balancing und Authentifizierung
  • Design und Weiterentwicklung des Tenant-Konzepts: isolierte Kundenumgebungen, Verantwortung für Architektur und Lifecycle
  • Abstimmung mit der Entwicklung zu performance- und verfügbarkeitsrelevanten Anforderungen an das Cluster- und Tenant-Konzept
  • Weiterentwicklung des Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepts: Ein verteilter In-Memory Ansatz über mehrere Knoten (Schwarmtechnik), der die Echtzeitfähigkeit der Anwendungen im Normalbetrieb sicherstellt
Automatisieren und standardisieren
  • GitOps-Workflows über ArgoCD und Fleet — von der Er

title: Immobilienmakler (m/w/d) – Schwerpunkt Vermietung | Werkstudent oder Teilzeit
description:
Warum LPE Immobilien?

  • Du wirst eingearbeitet, bevor du loslegst. Die ersten Wochen läufst du mit, schaust zu und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt. Erst wenn du sicher bist, bekommst du eigene Objekte — nicht am ersten Tag.
  • Du lernst den Markt an der schnellsten Stelle kennen. Vermietung ist der Bereich, in dem man am schnellsten versteht, wie Immobilien funktionieren: warum sich eine Wohnung in drei Tagen vermietet und die im selben Haus in sechs Wochen nicht.
  • Du sprichst selbst mit Kunden. Interessenten, Mieter, Eigentümer. Du bist vor Ort das Gesicht von LPE und nicht die Stimme im Hintergrund.
  • Du hast einen festen Ansprechpartner.

title: Fluidic System Engineer / Architect (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission

As a full-time member of our Orbital Systems team in Munich/Germany, you will work on defining the architecture of fluidic systems for spacecraft propulsion and other functions, working closely with a multi-disciplinary team. We work on projects ranging from launcher propulsion systems to orbital refuelling systems.

Your role will include:

  • Defining fluidic systems' architectures, working closely with other domain architects
  • Performing fluidic systems' simulations (performance calculations, steady and transient CFD, thermal and others)
  • Systems Engineering, incl. Requirements Engineering and MBSE
  • Technical leadership
  • Driving MAIT, incl. hands-on support
  • Co-ordinating design and mechanical engineers
  • Direct interfacing with customers and suppliers
  • Supporting proposal preparation


Your profile

We are seeking engineers with demonstrated expertise in fluidic systems. Candidates with 3+ years of relevant experience are encouraged to apply. We are also interested in more experienced professionals with 10+ years of experience in fluidic system architecture and leadership. The position level, scope, and compensation will be determined based on the candidate's experience and demonstrated impact.

Ideally, your experience includes:

  • Knowledge of space systems and subsystems
  • Propulsion systems architecture, including HTP and/or hydrazine/MMH
  • Propellants ground handling experience including safety requirements
  • Fluidic system simulations, with knowledge of ECOSIM / ESPSS, Simulink, Matlab
  • Familiarity with MBSE concepts and requirements engineering principles; ECSS
  • Strong analytical and communication skills
  • Hands-on mindset for hardware related activities
  • Proactive, structured, and able to work independently and in a team

title: Firmware Engineer
description:
termios builds smart thermostats for real estate. Our product — termios Pro — replaces standard radiator thermostats in existing buildings, performs hydraulic balancing via a self-learning algorithm, and cuts heating energy consumption by up to 30%. No battery, no retrofitting: the device harvests energy from the temperature differential between radiator and room air (thermo-harvesting) and communicates over LoRaWAN.

The system runs at scale across multi-unit residential portfolios. Each thermostat is a constrained embedded device operating autonomously, syncing state through a LoRaWAN gateway to a cloud backend that runs the optimization logic. We're 35 people, growing, and the firmware team is small — your work ships directly to devices in real apartments.

The firmware running on our smart thermostats — from first commit to field rollout. You write code, solder, measure, debug. No handoffs to someone else when it gets hard.

  • LoRaWAN communication stack (implementation + maintenance)
  • Low-power / energy harvesting optimization
  • OTA update mechanisms
  • Automated Hardware-in-the-loop test infrastructure (build, operate, extend)
  • Release process, Definition of Done, RED/CRA compliance
  • Field monitoring dashboards and post-rollout quality

Requirements

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years embedded/firmware development in C / C embedded
  • ARM Cortex-M architecture (bare-metal and/or RTOS)
  • Experience in Low-power design and energy efficiency
  • Knowledge of common communication protocols such as UART, I2C, SPI and hardware debugging: JTAG/SWD, logic analyzer, oscilloscope
  • Python for test automation and data analysis
  • Embedded security fundamentals
  • Degree in related engineering field

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Vil du kombinere teknologi, relasjonsbygging og kommersiell utvikling – og samtidig hjelpe virksomheter med å skape bedre struktur, kvalitet og kontroll? Til Datakvalitet AS søker vi nå en Customer Success Manager som vil få en sentral rolle i å utvikle eksisterende kunder og bidra til selskapets videre vekst.     Datakvalitet leverer SaaS-løsninger for kvalitets- og virksomhetsstyring til kunder i både offentlig og privat sektor. Plattformen støtter blant annet dokumentstyring, risikoanalyse, revisjon, compliance og avviksbehandling – og hjelper virksomheter med å få bedre kontroll på prosesser som er kritiske for den daglige driften.     Som en del av WeKomply Group, med kontorer i Tromsø, Oslo og Gøteborg, er Datakvalitet inne i en spennende utviklingsfase. Nå styrker selskapet satsingen på Customer Success og ser etter deg som motiveres av å forstå kundens behov, bygge sterke relasjoner og finne nye måter teknologien kan skape verdi på.  Om rollen  Som Customer Success Manager får du ansvar for en betydelig del av Datakvalitets kundeportefølje og blir en sentral sparringspartner for kundene dine.     Oppgaven handler om mer enn å sørge for fornøyde kunder. Du skal forstå hvordan kundene jobber, hva de ønsker å oppnå og hvor det finnes potensial for å bruke Datakvalitets løsninger enda bedre.  Hvordan jobber kunden i dag? Hvor oppstår utfordringene? Hvilke behov kommer fremover – og hvordan kan løsningen brukes smartere?     Du skal jobbe proaktivt med å utvikle eksisterende kunder og identifisere nye muligheter i porteføljen. Det handler om å øke antall brukere, få flere kunder til å ta i bruk relevante moduler, redusere churn og bidra til økt ARR – samtidig som kundene får mer verdi ut av løsningene.     Stillingen er basert på Skøyen i Oslo, med tett samarbeid med konsulentmiljøet i Tromsø og kolleger innen salg, utvikling og ledelse.      Dette vil du jobbe med    Eie og utvikle en definert portefølje av eksisterende kunder  Bygge sterke og langsiktige kunderelasjoner  Gjennomføre proaktiv og strukturert kundeoppfølging  Forstå kundenes virksomhet, arbeidsprosesser og utviklingsbehov  Bidra til økt brukeradopsjon og aktiv bruk av løsningen  Identifisere muligheter for flere brukere, nye moduler og økt kundeverdi  Rådgive kundene om hvordan de kan få større verdi ut av Datakvalitets løsninger  Fange opp risiko for redusert bruk eller churn – og ta tak i dette tidlig  Sikre god struktur og dokumentasjon av kundeoppfølgingen i CRM  Samarbeide tett med konsulenter, utviklere og kommersielle ressurser  Bidra til å videreutvikle hvordan Datakvalitet jobber med Customer Success       Hvem ser vi etter?   Vi tror du har erfaring med B2B-kunder, kundeutvikling, løsningssalg eller rådgivning, gjerne fra SaaS, programvare eller andre teknologibaserte tjenester. Du kan for eksempel ha en kommersiell eller økonomisk utdanning, men vi er først og fremst opptatt av hva du har gjort, hvordan du jobber og hva som motiverer deg.     Du trenger ikke å vær

Mitä odotamme sinulta?     Sinulla on positiivinen ja tavoitteellinen työote sekä aito halu kehittää tiimiläistesi osaamista, asiakaskokemusta ja myynnillistä tekemistä. Olet helposti lähestyttävä, mutta samalla määrätietoinen esihenkilö, joka uskaltaa asettaa selkeät odotukset, seurata tuloksia ja ohjata tekemistä oikeaan suuntaan. Osaat innostaa, kannustaa ja sitouttaa tiimiäsi yhteisiin tavoitteisiin sekä kommunikoida vakuuttavasti eri tilanteissa. Kokemusta ja näyttöjä asiakaslähtöisestä tuote- ja palvelumyynnistä. Kehitysmyönteisyyttä sekä intoa oppia uutta.    Vakuuttavia vuorovaikutus- ja kommunikointitaitoja suomeksi ja englanniksi sekä kykyä viestiä selkeästi, innostavasti ja tilanteeseen sopivalla tavalla erilaisten ihmisten kanssa. Bravida søger en Teamleder til vores Fælles Kundecenter med base i Kolding. Vi leder efter dig, der er en tydelig og tillidsskabende leder med et stærkt overblik og evne til at skabe struktur i komplekse sammenhænge. Du trives i en rolle med mange interessenter og arbejder naturligt med koordinering og samarbejde.  Vi forestiller os, at du har:    En administrativ uddannelse eller tilsvarende erfaring  Erfaring med ledelse eller koordinering af teams  En stærk systemforståelse og struktureret tilgang til arbejdet  Erfaring med kontrakter, fakturering og administrative processer  Evne til at kommunikere professionelt og opbygge stærke relationer  En tillidsskabende og samarbejdsorienteret tilgang     Hos os får du   Hos Bravida bliver du en del af Nordens førende leverandør af tekniske installations- og serviceydelser. I Fælles Kundecenter arbejder vi tæt sammen om at understøtte forretningen og sikre en professionelle og værdiskabende leverancer.  Du bliver en del af en organisation, hvor samarbejde på tværs er en styrke, og hvor vi arbejder som ét Bravida. Du får et stærkt fagligt netværk, gode udviklingsmuligheder og en arbejdsplads med fokus på trivsel og et godt arbejdsmiljø. title: Souschef til Q8 Farum, 37 timer
location: Farum, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: Ansøg senest: 10. oktober 2026    On-site      Jobbeskrivelse    Vil du være med til at udvikle andre    ,   samtidig med at du selv vokser med ledelsesopgaven? Og kan du se dig selv stortrives i en hverdag, hvor du står i front overfor både kunder og kolleger – og samtidig er den, der skaber struktur bag kulissen?    Så står vi klar med en lederstilling, hvor du får reel indflydelse på at forme hverdagen og skabe rammerne for succes på din servicestation. Det kan være dit livs måske vigtigste job. Seriøst.   ”Du får både muligheden for at udvikle servicestationen, nye og erfarne kolleger – og ikke mindst dig selv. Her sker altid noget nyt, og der kan godt være fart på. Det holder hverdagen spændende”  – souschef, Kim.   Velkommen til en virksomhed,   der skaber muligheder   – og til et stærkt og støttende netværk   Q8 er en af Danmarks største servicestationskæder og en virksomhed i bevægelse. Vi arbejder aktivt for at reducere vores klimapåvirkning og er i gang med at omstille vores forretning til fremtidens mobilitet.  Du og din nye servicestation bliver altså en del af noget større, og det kommer du til at mærke i hverdagen. For du får et tæt samarbejde med forretningschefen og kollegerne på hovedkontoret. Så selvom ansvaret er stort, kommer du aldrig til at stå alene.  Som souschef hos os får du en grundløn, og derudover får du en bonusordning, pension, sundhedsforsikring, gode fordele, rabatter samt 5 feriefridage pr. år.   En hverdag med kundeservice, ledelse og praktisk drift   Du er med til at sætte retningen og sikre, at alt spiller – både på gulvet og i baglokalet. Og din tilgang får stor betydning for både kundeoplevelsen og teamets trivsel, da du er rollemodel for den gode kultur. Du arbejder 37 timer om ugen og ligesom resten af holdet, kan du få vagter alle ugens dage. Stillingen er månedslønnet og din løn vil fastsættes efter kvalifikationer og aftales individuelt.  Du kommer bl.a. til at:    tage ansvar for driften, fx ved at udarbejde vagtplaner, bestille varer og følge op på salgsmål  være synlig på gulvet, hvor du guider teamet, motiverer dine kolleger og sikrer, at kunderne får en god oplevelse  være med til at rekruttere nye kolleger og stå for onboarding og oplæring  tage ansvar for implementering af nye kampagner, koncepter og produkter  løse dagligdagens praktiske opgaver og sørge for, at alt fra ovne og pølsegrills til sikkerhedsprocedurer spiller.      ”Der sker mange uforudsete ting på stationen, så der kan være et højt tempo, men jeg elsker de mange forskellige udfordringer, jeg møder hver dag. Det kræver en vis modenhed, men du skal ikke bare bange for at springe ud i det.”  – Souschef, Mathilde  Dine kvalifikationer   Du kan booste både salgstal og trivsel   Vi forventer ikke, at du har ledelseserfaring. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at være med til at skabe gode kundeoplevelser, og at du har blik for, hvordan en servicestation fungerer bedst – både som arbejdsplads og forretning. We build AI-powered tools: from CRM and inventory management to predictive analytics and digital advertising, that help manufacturers and dealerships sell smarter and deliver better customer experiences. 90% of European automotive manufacturers run on our SparK Platform, alongside 6,000+ dealerships across the continent.   We move fast, we think big, and AI is at the core of everything we do, not as a buzzword, but as the engine behind every product decision we make. We're building a team of people who are genuinely curious about AI, who experiment with it, push it, and find new ways to use it to solve real problems.   We're looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our Sales and Customer Success team in our Paris office.    The Role    The Customer Success Manager role will cover a wide range of account management, onboarding, and client growth tasks, as it liaises with the Delivery, Sales, and Product teams. The Customer Success Manager will:    Serve as the primary reference point for clients throughout their entire lifecycle with MotorK, taking full account management ownership  Own the customer onboarding journey from contract signature to successful product go-live, ensuring product activation aligns with the dealer's digital strategy and signed SLA  Conduct structured onboarding sessions, translate client requirements into clear delivery briefs, and manage cross-functional execution  Drive adoption, prevent churn, and execute upselling/cross-selling activities to meet individual and team revenue goals  Provide ongoing digital marketing, lead generation, and lead management expertise using the DealerK Method  Track and report on key account metrics, including NPS, retention, time-to-go-live, and product adoption rates     Requirements       Our ideal Customer Success Manager will have previous experience in Sales, Account Management, or Customer Success (ideally within a SaaS or digital product environment) and digital marketing strategy knowledge.   As well as:    Previous experience in account management or customer success, with a strong plus for end-to-end customer onboarding ownership  Deep understanding of the B2B automotive dealer sector and web technologies (CMS, SEO concepts) or SaaS industry  Project management mindset with proven ability to bridge business requirements and technical delivery teams  Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, and relationship-building skills  Native French speaker, fluency in English  A proactive, goal-oriented approach with a passion for digital technologies and automotive innovation     Work Pattern and Location     Permanent contract, full time  Monday - Friday  Hybrid role with occasional field trips across the country     Benefits      Salary range: 40k-50k depending on experience  Commission plan: between 10 and 20% of fixed salary  C

title: Key Account Manager – Living

description: Vil du være en del af en kreativ og værdidrevet virksomhed, hvor du er tæt på beslutningerne og kan gøre en mærkbar forskel? DDI Group søger en skarp hjerne med flair for primært online salg og datadrevet vækst. Jobbet er en kombination af salg, analyse, strategi, forretningsudvikling samt online kommerciel forståelse. Vi har brug for dig, der forstår hvad der skal til for at arbejde tæt sammen med og udvikle nogle af de vigtigste e-tail kunder i Europa.     Hos DDI Group er vi midt i en spændende vækstrejse. Vi styrker vores salgsorganisation og leder nu efter en ny kollega til vores kontor i indre København, til at tage ansvar for blandt andet nogle af vores vigtigste e-tailers. Du bliver en nøgleperson i Living med primært ansvar for brandet Gejst. Du vil arbejde med primært e-tail kunder men også udvalgte retail kunder. Du vil skulle sikre en tæt relation til vores partnere, facilitere partner årshjul, indsalg, mersalg, performance-analyse, og generelt kundeudvikling.      Om jobbet:   Du bliver en vigtig del af vores Living salgsteam, med primært fokus på vores større online kunder og key accounts. Du vil arbejde målrettet med egne kunder men også på tværs i forbindelse med krydssalg. Du vil have fokus på at optimere nye og eksisterende kunder og sikre at de performer bedst muligt. Du vil have arbejdsplads på vores kontor og showroom på Frederiksgade i København og arbejde med primært fokus på brandet Gejst og de brands der vil ligge under vores premium søjle i Living afdelingen.      Det kommer du til at arbejde med:    Daglig kontakt og relationsopbygning med vores største online e-tail kunder og key accounts  Analyse af salg, performance og sortiment, og forslag til optimering  Udarbejdelse og opfølgning på kundeplaner, årshjul og kommercielle tiltag  Proaktiv identificering og realisering af salgspotentiale hos både eksisterende og nye kunder  Tæt samarbejde med vores salgs-, marketing- og produktteams  En aktiv rolle i at udvikle, hvordan vi tænker salget fremadrettet       Vi forestiller os, at du:    Har erfaring med e-tail, retail eller salgsanalyse. Måske som KAM, E-tail specialist eller lignende  Har erfaring fra interiør og møbel eller livsstil branchen  Har en skarp analytisk hjerne og elsker at finde mønstre i data  Forstår samspillet mellem sortiment, branding og performance  Er struktureret, nysgerrig og trives med ansvar  Har god forretningsforståelse og evner at tænke 3 skridt frem  Positiv, imødekommende og energifyldt som elsker at skabe resultater sammen  Er en igangsætter som elsker struktur og udvikling  Motiveres af at arbejde i en vækstvirksomhed med høje ambitioner  Du kan forhandle på dansk og engelsk. Andre sprog som tysk er et plus       Vi tilbyder:    En hverdag i en spændende og værdidrevet virksomhed i vækst  En central rolle med masser af ansvar samt gode personlige og faglige udviklingsmuligheder  Uformel arbejdskultur med højt tempo og godt humør  Fantastiske kolleger og sociale arrangementer       Om os

title: Senior Account Manager, SMB
description: The Company  PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.  We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.  We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. En lien direct avec le Head of Growth, vous intervenez sur l'ensemble de la chaîne CRM : stratégie, segmentation, marketing automation, campagnes multicanales, analyse de la performance et optimisation continue.     1.Définition de la stratégie CRM & Lifecycle   Définir la stratégie CRM et la segmentation des utilisateurs selon leurs comportements, leurs usages et leur cycle de vie.  Construire les parcours CRM adaptés aux différents segments afin d'améliorer l'engagement et la rétention.  Identifier les données nécessaires pour enrichir la connaissance utilisateur et personnaliser les interactions.  Participer activement à la structuration de la stratégie Lifecycle de l'entreprise.      2.Marketing Automation & campagnes multicanales   Concevoir et déployer les scénarios CRM (onboarding, activation, nurturing, réactivation, winback...).  Piloter les campagnes sur l'ensemble des canaux (email, SMS, push notifications, messages in-app...).  Définir les messages et coordonner leur production avec les équipes Marketing et Éditoriales.  Mettre en place une démarche d'amélioration continue via des A/B tests et des expérimentations régulières.      3.Data & optimisation des parcours utilisateurs   Développer les dispositifs de collecte de données afin d'améliorer la connaissance client.  Optimiser les parcours utilisateurs en collaboration avec les équipes Produit.  Garantir la qualité des données CRM ainsi que le respect des réglementations RGPD.  Identifier les points de friction et proposer des recommandations d'amélioration.      4.Pilotage de la performance   Définir et suivre les principaux KPI CRM (engagement, rétention, churn, LTV, taux d'ouverture, taux de clic...).  Construire les reportings et analyser les performances des campagnes.  Identifier les leviers de croissance et recommander les optimisations nécessaires.      5.Collaboration transverse   Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Produit, Data, Marketing, Growth et Éditoriales.  Diffuser une culture orientée utilisateur et data au sein de l'entreprise.  Participer aux réflexions autour de l'évolution des outils, des parcours et des pratiques CRM.       Profil recherché    3 à 5 ans d'expérience minimum en CRM, Lifecycle M

title: 셀러 세일즈 매니저 (경력 3년~)
description: 회사 소개   쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.  쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.  쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.      직무 소개   Account Management 팀은 판매자의 성장을 지원하고 Marketplace의 지속적인 비즈니스 성과 향상에 기여하는 조직입니다. 담당 셀러의 비즈니스 현황을 분석하고 성장 기회를 발굴하여 매출 확대를 위한 전략을 제안합니다. 셀러와 긴밀하게 협업하며 프로모션, 가격 경쟁력, 상품 운영 등 다양한 성장 활동을 지원합니다. 데이터 기반의 인사이트와 컨설팅을 통해 셀러의 비즈니스 성과 개선 및 장기적인 파트너십 구축을 목표로 합니다.      업무 내용    마켓플레이스 셀러의 포트폴리오를 관리하며, 비즈니스 현황을 분석하고 성장 기회를 발굴  마켓플레이스 셀러의 비즈니스 현황과 주요 성과 (매출, 트래픽, 전환율 등) 지표를 분석하고, 매출 성장을 위한 영업 전략 수립·실행  프로모션, 상품 운영 개선 등을 통해 셀러의 비즈니스 성과 향상 지원  셀러의 니즈와 문제점을 파악하고 데이터 기반의 솔루션을 제안하여 지속적인 성장을 지원       자격   요건    영업, Account Management, Business Development 또는 관련 분야에서 최소 3년 이상의 경력을 보유하신 분  고객 또는 파트너 비즈니스 관리 경험이 있으신 분  데이터와 지표를 기반으로 문제를 분석하고 해결한 경험이 있으신 분  우수한 커뮤니케이션 및 관계 구축 역량이 있으신 분  목표 달성을 위한 강한 실행력과 오너십을 가지신 분  빠르게 변화하는 환경에서 우선순위를 설정하고 다양한 과제를 효과적으로 관리할 수 있는 분  셀러의 니즈를 깊이 이해하고 데이터 기반의 솔루션을 통해 비즈니스 성과를 개선한 경험이 있으신 분       우대   사항    이커머스 또는 온라인 플랫폼 관련 경험이 있으신 분  B2B 영업 또는 고객 관리 경험이 있으신 분  판매자 관리 또는 고객 성공(Customer Success) 경험이 있으신 분  Excel, SQL 또는 BI Tool 활용 경험이 있으신 분       전형 절차 및 안내 사항    전형절차    서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격  전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.  전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.    참고사항    본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.  지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.  취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.  직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.  채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.  고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12 주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.       개인정보 처리방침    쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/    서류 반환 정책    본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.  당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.  위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.  당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류

description: Vi i Domstoladministrasjonen bidrar til Norges domstolers oppdrag som samfunnets viktigste konfliktløser. Det gjør vi gjennom å utvikle fellesløsninger, slik at domstolene kan konsentrere seg som sine hovedoppgaver i dag og i fremtiden. Brukersenteret er nylig etablert som en egen gruppe i Seksjon for digital arbeidsplass. Brukersenteret er intern førstelinje for IT-støtte til Norges domstoler og har en sentral rolle i å sikre stabil drift, gode brukeropplevelser og effektiv innføring av nye IT-løsninger. Det er totalt ca. 2000 brukere.  Vi har nå ledig stilling som gruppeleder. Gruppeleder vil rapportere til seksjonssjef for Digital Arbeidsplass. Du motiveres av å utvikle mennesker og fagmiljø.       Vi tilbyr   I tillegg til en jobb som er viktig for både enkeltpersoner og samfunnet får du:   muligheten til å utvi

title: Order Management Team Lead
description: Order Management Team Lead - Tilaustenhallinnan tiimivetäjä       Johda ja kehitä tilaustenhallintaa kansainvälisessä liiketoimintaympäristössä – ja ole mukana rakentamassa sujuvaa asiakaskokemusta joka päivä.       Asiakasyrityksemme   Safeplast Oy on ollut vuodesta 2022 osa Caplugs-konsernia.  Caplugs perustettiin vuonna 1948 Buffalossa, New Yorkissa. Yritys valmistaa pääasiassa muovisia suojaustuotteita usealle teollisuuden alalle ympäri maailmaa.  Safeplast on erikoistunut korkealaatuisten muovisten spiraalien ja erikoistekstiilituotteiden valmistukseen pääasiassa kone- ja laitevalmistusteollisuudenalalle.      Vastuualueet    Johda ja kehitä tilaustenhallintaprosessia ja osallistu aktiivisesti tiimin päivittäisiin operatiivisiin tehtäviin.  Varmista asiakastilausten oikea-aikainen ja tarkka käsittely.  OTIF (on time in full – toimitukset ajallaan ja täysimääräisenä) on keskeinen KPI-mittarisi ja johtamisvastuusi.  Varmista, että kaikki tarvittava dokumentaatio on asianmukaisesti ylläpidetty ja ajan tasalla.  Kehitä työtapoja ja prosesseja yhteistyössä sisäisten sidosryhmien kanssa.  Osallistu haastaviin toimitus- ja asiakastilausten ratkaisuihin.  Tue ja ohjaa tilaustenhallintatiimiä sen päivittäisessä työssä.  Tuota luotettavaa raportointia ja säännöllisiä päivityksiä johdolle.       Mitä odotamme sinulta    Tehtävään soveltuva koulutustausta.  Kokemusta tilaustenhallinnasta, asiakaspalvelusta ja logistiikasta.  Kokemusta ERP-järjestelmistä; Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Centralin tuntemus katsotaan eduksi.  Vahvat analyyttiset taidot sekä kyky johtaa ja hallita prosesseja päästä päähän.  Erinomaiset yhteistyö- ja viestintätaidot.  Sujuva suomen ja englannin kielen taito; saksan kielen taito katsotaan eduksi.  Joustavuutta työaikojen suhteen – kansainvälisenä yrityksenä meillä voi olla kokouksia myös tavanomaisen työajan ulkopuolella.  Halua tehdä enemmän asiakastyytyväisyyden varmistamiseksi, vaikka se vaatisi joustavuutta työajan suhteen.  Esihenkilö tai tiimivastaavan kokemusta.       Mitä tarjoamme    Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen roolin kansainvälisessä liiketoimintaympäristössä.  Mahdollisuuden kehittää prosesseja ja vaikuttaa liiketoiminnan menestykseen.  Ammattitaitoisen, kannustavan ja tukea antavan työyhteisön.  Kilpailukykyisen palkan, joka määräytyy kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi mukaan.       Kiinnostuitko?   Mikäli kiinnostuitko tilaustenhallinnan tiimivetäjän tehtävästä, jätäthän hakemuksesi meille 20.9.2026 mennessä.     Lisätietoja tehtävästä: Hannele Könnömäki, Talent ValtaGroup, hannele.konnomaki@valtagroup.fi, +358 44 0339993.

title: Founding Customer Success Lead
description: Own everything after “yes”: pilot, onboarding, adoption, retention and expansion, plus the proof that comes out of it.     On-site in either Stockholm or Malmö.     Oplane is not a tool people buy and forget. It runs inside the coding loop, it finds real architectural risk in code that is still being written, and it only pays off when a customer’s engineers actually change what they do with it. Right now the people who make that happen are two founders and two customer-facing engineers, and there is no owner for what happens after a contract is signed.     You are that owner, and you are building the function from nothing. There is no onboarding playbook, no health model, no renewal motion. You will write all three while running live accounts yourself.     What you’ll own  Everything after “yes.” Pilot, onboarding, adoption, retention and expansion, plus the proof that comes out of happy customers.     What the job actually is  · Run pilots to a real outcome. Our pilots are short and strict, and success is a customer seeing a genuine finding in their own code and fixing it. You own that path from kickoff to decision.  · Understand the customer’s work better than they expect you to. How they ship, what their review process actually looks like, where security slows them down, who inside the company is under pressure and why. This is the core of the job. If you are not curious about somebody else’s engineering org, you will not enjoy it here.  · Get Oplane properly embedded. Into their repos, their CI, their pull request flow and their coding agents. You will be hands-on with technical setup, working alongside our engineers rather than handing it to them.  · Build the retention system. Health signals, adoption milestones, the difference between a customer who is using it and a customer who is depending on it. Then renewals and expansion, which follow from that rather than from a QBR calendar.  · Turn success into proof. Customer stories, references, joint sessions with our marketing and sales work. Our buyers trust other practitioners far more than they trust us, so the accounts you make successful become the reason the next ones sign.  · Feed the product. You will see every place the product creates friction before anyone else does, and we expect that to reach the engineers directly rather than through a quarterly summary.     Who this is for  · At least 4 years owning customers in a technical B2B product. We are looking for someone who has already done this well, not someone learning it here.  · You can point at retention and expansion numbers you personally influenced, and explain what you did to move them.  · You have genuinely spent time in the field with customers, in their tools and their meetings, making somebody’s job measurably easier. title: Aluepäällikkö
description: OUMAN on Pohjoismaiden suurin rakennusautomaatiojärjestelmien valmistaja. Yli 40 vuoden ajan olemme kehittäneet ja valmistaneet ratkaisuja, jotka parantavat tuhansien kiinteistöjen energiatehokkuutta vuosittain. Lämmönsäädinten valmistuksesta alkanut matkamme on kehittynyt kokonaisvaltaisiksi järjestelmiksi, jotka ohjaavat rakennusten kaikkia LVI-prosesseja. Suunnittelemme, kehitämme ja valmistamme tuotteemme itse. Kiinteistöjen energiankulutusta ohjaavat automaatiotuotteemme ovat avainasemassa, kun kehitämme energiajärjestelmäämme kohti hiilineutraalia tulevaisuutta.       Uskomme, että yhdessä saavutamme enemmän kuin yksin. Kulttuurimme perustuu yhteistyöhön, avoimuuteen ja sitoutumiseen huippuosaamiseen. Olitpa sitten tuotekehityksessä, tuotannossa, myynnissä tai asiakaspalvelussa, löydät työyhteisön jossa arvostetaan yhteistyötä, luottamusta ja yhteistä onnistumista. Meillä on matala hierarkia ja joustava työympäristö, jossa jokaisella on mahdollisuus vaikuttaa ja kehittyä. Voittava asenteemme ohjaa meitä löytämään parhaat ratkaisut, palvelemaan asiakkaitamme erinomaisesti ja kehittämään toimintaamme jatkuvasti. Tarjoamme työntekijöillemme monipuolisia ja vastuullisia tehtäviä, mahdollisuuksia osaamisen kehittämiseen sekä kansainvälisen työyhteisön, jota yhdistävät arvomme Together ja Winning Attitude.       Etsimme nyt       ALUEPÄÄLLIKKÖÄ       vahvistamaan tiimiämme Uudellamaalla.      Tiimisi vastaa Ouman tuotteiden, projektien ja palvelujen myynnistä sekä toteutuksesta Uudenmaan alueella. Tiimiisi kuuluu asiakaspäälliköitä ja projektitoiminnasta vastaava osasto. Yhteensä tiimiläisiä on noin 8.     Tehtävässäsi vastaat alueesi tuloksellisesta toiminnasta niin myynnin, tarjousten kuin projektitoteutusten osalta. Tehtävääsi kuuluu myös aktiivinen myyntityö yhdessä muiden asiakasvastaavien kanssa. Alueesi asiakaskuntaa ovat rakennusautomaatioyritykset, kunnat ja kaupungit, kiinteistön-omistajat, huoltoyhtiöt sekä useat LVI- prosessien kanssa työskentelevät urakoitsijat.     Olet luonteeltasi tuloshakuinen tiimipelaaja. Osaat tasapainottaa tavoitteellisen tekemisen, yhteistyön ja käytännönläheisen ongelmanratkaisun. Vaikka työssä on mahdollisuus osittaiseen etätyöhön, vaatii se myös läsnäoloa ja asiakastapaamisia.      Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää   Sinulla on kaupallista kokemusta ja myynnillinen asenne sekä vankkaa osaamista rakennus-automaatiosta tai LVI-toimialalta. Sinulla tulisi olla kokemusta myös projektiliiketoiminnasta. Tulet toimeen suomen kielen lisäksi englannin kielellä, ruotsin kielen osaaminen katsotaan eduksi. Vaikka aiempi esihenkilökokemus ei ole tehtävässä välttämätön, odotamme sinulta luontaista johtajuutta, kykyä saada ihmiset sitoutumaan yhteisiin tavoitteisiin sekä valmiutta toimia 8-henkisen tiimin esihenkilönä. title: Global Customer Director

Sicherstellung einheitlicher Prozesse für Garantieabwicklungen, Retouren, Exportkontrollen und die systematische Handhabung von Produktabweichungen. title: ERP Consultant & IT Projektleiter (m/w/d)
description: Digitale Transformation braucht starke Partner – und genau das bietet unser Rocken Partner als etablierter IT-Dienstleister. Der Fokus liegt auf massgeschneiderten Lösungen: von leistungsstarken ERP-Systemen über moderne Arbeitsplatzkonzepte bis hin zu umfassenden Cybersecurity-Massnahmen. Das Team arbeitet präzise, zuverlässig und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch. Moderne Technologien treffen auf persönliche Kundennähe. Bereit, die digitale Zukunft mitzugestalten? Dann werde Teil des Teams unseres Rocken Partners und bringe deine Expertise ein.   Rolle    Technologie verstehen. Prozesse gestalten. Projekte bewegen.   Gesucht wird eine technisch versierte Persönlichkeit, die ERP-Systeme nicht nur administriert, sondern deren Weiterentwicklung aktiv vorantreibt. In dieser Rolle verbinden sich  IT-Systemtechnik, Business-Prozesse und modernes Projektmanagement  zu einer vielseitigen Aufgabe mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum.   Verantwortung     Analyse und Optimierung bestehender ERP-Prozesse und Systemlandschaften  Planung und Leitung anspruchsvoller IT- und ERP-Projekte  Koordination von internen Fachbereichen, IT-Spezialisten und externen Partnern  Übersetzung fachlicher Anforderungen in technisch umsetzbare Lösungen  Begleitung von ERP-Weiterentwicklungen, Releases, Migrationen und Integrationen  Identifikation von Optimierungspotenzialen entlang digitaler Geschäftsprozesse  Konzeption und Umsetzung von Schnittstellen zwischen ERP, Drittsystemen und modernen Cloud-Lösungen  Erstellung von technischen Konzepten, Prozessmodellen und Projektplänen  Steuerung von Terminen, Prioritäten, Budgets und Projektabhängigkeiten  Beratung der Fachbereiche bei technischen und systembezogenen Fragestellungen  Weiterentwicklung der ERP-Systemlandschaft mit Blick auf Automatisierung und Digitalisierung     Qualifikationen     Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich Informatik, IT-Systemtechnik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar  Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit ERP-Systemen, IT-Projekten oder Business Applications  Fundiertes Verständnis für IT-Infrastrukturen, Applikationen, Schnittstellen und Systemarchitekturen  Erfahrung in der Planung und Umsetzung von IT- oder ERP-Projekten  Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Zusammenhänge verständlich zu vermitteln  Analytische und lösungsorientierte Denkweise  Selbstständige Arbeitsweise und ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein  Interesse an Digitalisierung, Prozessautomatisierung und modernen IT-Technologien     Benefits     Coaching und Mentoring  Attraktive Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten  Komfortables Büro mit moderner Infrastruktur  Interessante und abwechslungsreiche

Customers include the FIA (in F1, F2, F3, F1 Academy, FE and WEC), nine Formula 1 teams (including the 8-time World Champion Mercedes AMG Petronas F1 Team), the majority of Formula E teams, the winners of multiple Le Mans 24-hour races over the last 10 years (Audi, Porsche, and Toyota) and teams and organisers in both IndyCar and NASCAR.

title: Director of Software Engineering

The Role:

 

Spire is making a fundamental shift in how it operates its constellation. We are moving from a model where trained operators watch dashboards and escalate to experts, to one where the system is fully autonomous, self-healing, and data intelligent. This Director will lead that transformation. You will set the technical vision, define the architecture, build and inspire the team, and personally raise the standard for what modern space operations look like. 

The old model relies on operators, escalations, manual processes, and institutional knowledge locked in the heads of a few experts. It does not scale and it does not belong in a modern space company. We know what we want to replace it with: SRE principles applied to a constellation, autonomous fault handling, AI-driven anomaly detection, low toil, high data quality, and continuous improvement baked into the system. 


What This Role Is Not: 

This is not a role for someone who wants to graduate out of technical work. If your ideal week is back-to-back 1:1s, sprint ceremonies, and stakeholder syncs, this is not the right fit. We need a director who writes code, reviews architecture, challenges technical decisions, and earns the team's respect through demonstrated craft and not just tenure or title.

Technical Leadership

  • Set the architectural direction for the data platform, reliability systems, and automation infrastructure

  • Precision & Documentation: You ensure our measurement data is rock-solid. This includes regular calibration of analytical instruments, maintaining detailed lab journals, and assisting in drafting clear SOPs.

  • Safety & Organization: You maintain a safe, high-standard working environment (GLP) and ensure analytical equipment is always ready for the next run.


Your profile

  • Education: Successfully completed vocational training as a CTA (Chemical Technical Assistant), Chemielaborant, or a similar technical background. Academic degrees or Techniker qualifications are considered, but this is a hands-on technical role where practical bench experience is our top priority.

title: Fachinformatiker Systemintegration (m/w/d) vor Ort | Es ist kein Job - Wir leben IT!
description:
Wir leben IT.

Eigentlich suchen wir keinen Mitarbeiter. Wir suchen jemanden, der Lust hat, mit uns IT zu machen.

Wir sind ein kleines Team mit einer großen Leidenschaft für Technik. Uns begeistert alles, was blinkt, piept, sich virtualisieren lässt oder einfach nur funktioniert, nachdem wir daran geschraubt haben. Neue Technologien probieren wir lieber selbst aus, als nur darüber zu lesen.

Unsere Kunden verlassen sich darauf, dass ihre IT läuft. Deshalb sind wir da, wenn es darauf ankommt – meistens per Remotezugriff, manchmal aber auch direkt vor Ort. Mal geht es um Server, Virtualisierung oder Netzwerke, mal erklären wir einem Kunden zum dritten Mal, warum der Monitor tatsächlich eingeschaltet sein muss. Wir nennen das liebevoll „betreutes Arbeiten“ – und meistens können wir anschließend gemeinsam darüber lachen.

Bei uns gibt es keine Konzernstrukturen und keine langen Entscheidungswege. Wir arbeiten unkompliziert zusammen, kommunizieren direkt und helfen uns gegenseitig – egal ob im Büro, im Homeoffice oder unterwegs.

Und ja: Wenn wir Lust haben, gehen wir gemeinsam mit Kunden oder anderen ITlern zum Chinesen oder ins Steakhaus. Nicht weil das irgendwo vorgeschrieben ist, sondern weil wir uns gut verstehen.

Wenn Du morgens eher denkst „Mal sehen, was heute kaputt ist“ als „Schon wieder Montag“, dann könnten wir ziemlich gut zusammenpassen.

Kurz gesagt: Wir leben IT. Nicht nur zwischen 8 und 17 Uhr.

Aufgaben

Jeder Tag ist anders – genau deshalb macht der Job bei uns Spaß.

Du bist der erste Ansprechpartner, wenn beim Kunden die IT mal wieder beschlossen hat, ein Eigenleben zu entwickeln.

Die meisten Probleme lassen sich per Remotezugriff lösen, wenn es aber sinnvoller ist, fährst Du direkt zum Kunden und bringst die Technik wieder zum Laufen.

Du installierst und betreust Windows-Clients, Windows-Server, Microsoft 365 sowie alles, was in einer modernen IT-Umgebung dazugehört.

title: Founding Product Manager (m/w/d)
description:
You'll join an early-stage, AI-native startup with a product that has already proven market fit. We build cutting-edge AI solutions for Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) for enterprises around the world.

Our customers are auditors, risk managers, and compliance teams, which means evaluation rigor, auditability, and EU AI Act readiness aren't afterthoughts for us. They're product requirements.

Tasks

As our first Product Manager, you'll own product end-to-end and work directly alongside the founding team. You will:

  • Own product discovery and be accountable for outcomes — we hand you problems and constraints, not solutions. You're measured on the value you create for customers and the business, not on features shipped.
  • Own the roadmap and prioritization — driven by customer evidence and company strategy, not by whoever shouts loudest. We do not want a sales-driven roadmap, and neither will you.
  • Drive customer discovery yourself — you'll be in front of auditors, risk managers, and compliance teams regularly. We have strong customer relationships and access is provided, but you make it happen; nobody hands it to you.
  • Build the product operating model from scratch — discovery cadence, how we decide what to build, how product, design, and engineering work as one team. You're our first PM; you set the standard.
  • Work as one team with design and engineering — addressing value, usability, and feasibility together, not throwing requirements over a wall.
  • Partner with our CEO on go-to-market and pricing — you bring the product and customer evidence; he owns the commercial side. You'll collaborate closely.
  • Become a GRC expert, fast — controls, RACM, audit evidence, the regulatory frameworks. We'll backstop you, but you'll own becoming fluent.

title: Embedded Software-Entwicklung Vollzeit (M/W/D) C, ESP32, BLE, IoT
description:
Irgendwo an einem norwegischen Fjord steht gerade ein Camper im Regen. Drinnen ist es warm, weil eine Firmware zuverlässig ihren Job macht. Vielleicht bald Deine.

REVOTION digitalisiert die Yacht- und Campingbranche. Wir entwickeln ein smartes Bordsystem für Caravans, Camper, Boote und Yachten: Heizung, Licht, Batterien, Tanks und Sensoren, alles vernetzt, alles per App und Touchscreen steuerbar. Das Herzstück sind unsere eigenen Hardware-Module: das BRAIN (Zentralrechner mit Bluetooth, LTE-M und GPS) und unsere NODEs (Schalt-, Batterie-, Tank-, Temperatur- und Klimamodule). Gestartet in einer Garage, ausgezeichnet mit dem European Innovation Award. Und auf jedem einzelnen Modul läuft Firmware, die wir selbst geschrieben haben.

Genau dafür suchen wir Dich: einen erfahrenen Embedded-Softwareentwickler, der nicht nur Tickets abarbeitet, sondern die Firmware-Architektur mitprägt. Wir sind ein kleines Team aus Düsseldorf. Das heißt: kurze Wege, echte Verantwortung, und Deine Entscheidungen landen nicht in einem Backlog, sondern auf Geräten, die Menschen jeden Tag benutzen.

Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst unsere Firmware in C für BRAIN- und NODE-Module weiter (ESP32-S3, FreeRTOS/ESP-IDF) und prägst dabei mit, wie sie in fünf Jahren aussieht
  • Du gestaltest unsere BLE-Schnittstellen zwischen Modulen und App
  • Du bringst Drittgeräte zum Sprechen: Heizungen, Batterien, Wechselrichter und Sensorik namhafter Hersteller, über CAN, RS-485/Modbus und VEDirect
  • Du verantwortest OTA-Updates, Diagnose und Logging für eine wachsende Geräteflotte im Feld
  • Du debuggst hardware-nah, gemeinsam mit unserem Elektronik-Team direkt am Prototypen (Logic Analyzer, Oszilloskop, Bring-up)

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Embedded-Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise 5–1

title: Werkstudent Content Creation (m/w/d) | FRANKFURT

  • Leitung des AI War Rooms und bereichsübergreifende Steuerung der Umsetzung
  • Schulung von AI Champions und Sicherstellung der Akzeptanz in den Fachbereichen
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung, Development, RevOps, Vertrieb und Service

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Praxiserfahrung als AI Lead, AI Program Lead, AI Platform Lead, CTO oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle
  • Erfahrung in der Einführung von AI Gateways, LLM-Routing, RAG und agentischen Workflows

  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung bereichsübergreifender Teams und komplexer Transformationsprojekte

title: Junior Client Service Associate (m/w/d)
description:
Im Zuge unseres starken Wachstums brauchen wir Ihre Unterstützung und suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Junior Client Service Associate (m/w/d) für unseren Standort in Frankfurt in Voll- oder Teilzeit.

Ihr Einstieg in die Vermögensverwaltung

Sie interessieren sich für Kapitalmärkte, Vermögensverwaltung und die Betreuung anspruchsvoller Kunden? Sie möchten nicht jahrelang auf den nächsten Karriereschritt warten, sondern früh Verantwortung übernehmen und sich gezielt zum Kundenberater entwickeln?

Dann sind Sie bei Plutos genau richtig!

Die Plutos Vermögensverwaltung AG betreut seit über 30 Jahren vermögende Privatkunden in allen finanziellen Angelegenheiten. Mit mehr als 35 Mitarbeitern verwalten wir ein Kundenvermögen von über 700 Millionen Euro.

Für unser weiteres Wachstum suchen wir motivierte Nachwuchstalente, die ihre Karriere in der Vermögensverwaltung starten und sich zum Kundenberater entwickeln möchten.

Ihre Persprektive

Bei uns starten Sie nicht in einer Sackgasse.

description:

Co‑founded by industry pioneers, the company is on a mission to make BIM smarter, faster and more collaborative. With a growing team, neoBIM offers an innovative work environment, a flexible culture and the chance to work on impactful global projects.

We're hiring our founding designer to own the look, feel, and design system of the product from day one — and to do it in a way that's collapsing the old design-to-handoff pipeline.

How we think about design here

The traditional loop is: design in Figma → hand off → engineers translate to code → drift sets in → repeat. We don't want that. Tools like Claude now let designers express intent directly in code, working in the real design system instead of a mirror of it. So the only translation step left is designer-code → production-code — far closer, far less lossy.

We're not dogmatic about never opening a canvas to think. But the designer we want is someone who reaches for code as their primary medium and treats the running product as the source of truth.

Tasks

  • Define and build our design system in code, using shadcn/ui as the foundation — tokens, variants, modes, responsive behaviour, accessibility

  • Design the entire product surface — from the 3D canvas and viewport controls to property panels, dashboards, and onboarding flows
  • Own iconography and illustration: either craft our icon set and product illustrations yourself, or art-direct freelancers to deliver a consistent, high-quality visual language

description: About IMMA       Independent Multicultural Media Australia Ltd (IMMA) is the national peak body representing more than 60 independent multicultural media outlets across Australia. We advocate for equity in government and agency advertising, support training and digital transformation, and give multicultural media a strong collective voice.     Our members are the media. They are the publishers, broadcasters and digital outlets reaching audiences in language and in community every day in Australia, and they are the reason IMMA exists. You will identify where members need support, organise practical training, build the guidance and templates, and work with each outlet on a plan to get them where they need to be. Some members are already there. Many are not, and moving them along that pathway is the central measure of success in your first year.     You will also support the success of our advertising booking platform, Multicultural Media Direct (MMD). This includes overseeing campaign delivery once a booking is confirmed, working through MMD's operations team.     This role reports to the General Manager.
