description: Annature is an Australian-based digital signature, identity verification & payments company. Founded to challenge Docusign by putting transparency, fairness, and genuine customer service first, we pioneered Pay as you go pricing in the digital signing space, so our customers only pay for what they use.     We're lean, agile, and customer-focused — we'd rather ship the features that matter than pile on unnecessary complexity. Today we serve 8,000+ businesses and 120,000+ monthly active users across Australia, the UK, and the US, who've collectively signed more than 70 million envelopes together, spanning industries from legal and accounting to real estate, financial services, education, and NDIS.      The role      We're looking for someone to sit at the intersection of onboarding and account management — the human face of Annature for both brand-new signups and our existing customer base.     For new customers, you'll be the first real person they speak to after signing up. We have an outreach team that handles initial contact and demo bookings, and you'll take it from there: running one-on-one product tours, understanding what each customer is trying to achieve, and qualifying them so the right next steps happen. It's not a sales role, but sales-shaped questions will come up regularly — when they do, you'll know enough to answer the basics and bring in someone from sales for anything that needs a customised quote.     For existing customers, you will be their single, dedicated point of contact for anything account-related. We have a support team for when something's genuinely not working the way it should; your job is everything else — helping customers understand how to get the most out of the platform, answering "how do I..." and "what's the best way to..." questions with confidence, and knowing when an issue is actually a support issue.     There's also room to grow this role in a sales direction if you want it - more on that below.      What you'll be doing       Own an assigned portfolio of Annature customers as their dedicated point of contact for account-related enquiries.  Run one-on-one product demos and onboarding tours for new signups booked through our outreach team.  Qualify new signups — understand their use case, their team, and what they're trying to solve — so demos and follow-ups are relevant.  Answer day-to-day product and "how do I" questions confidently, escalating genuine technical or support issues to our support team rather than deflecting everything to them.  Recognise when a customer's needs point toward a customised subscription or commercial arrangement, and hand off warmly to the sales team.       If you want it: take on sales conversations yourself and work toward commission targets (see below — this is optional, not a requirement of the role). DroneShield (ASX:DRO) develops market-leading counter-drone solutions used by military organisations, government agencies, airports, critical infrastructure operators, and law enforcement operating in some of the most challenging and high-stakes environments in the world. Employees work at the forefront of innovation, solving complex technical problems and delivering mission-critical capabilities where performance, reliability, and speed matter.  As an ASX200-listed company and the world's only publicly listed pure-play counter-drone business, DroneShield is experiencing rapid growth. Revenue increased from A$57 million in 2024 to more than A$217 million in 2025, supported by record profitability, a global sales pipeline exceeding A$2.5 billion, and annual R&D investment of over A$50 million. DroneShield's Amsterdam office serves as the company's European hub, supporting regional customers, partnerships, and growth across defence, security, and critical infrastructure markets. This is a partner-first, post-sales role focused on onboarding, partner enablement, renewals, customer lifecycle coordination, operational follow-through, escalation ownership, Salesforce discipline, and clear communication across internal and external stakeholders. Du bliver en nøglespiller i at hjælpe vores kunder med at optimere deres processer og opnå synlige resultater gennem vores innovative løsninger og sparring. title: Customer Service Manager
description: Job Description    About Us   Longbridge is a leading, next-generation internet brokerage and fintech company established in Singapore in 2019. We provide a one-stop, multi-asset global investment platform offering access to SG, HK, and US markets, with innovative investment and trading solutions designed to make investing smarter, simpler, and more accessible.   About The Role   The Team Manager will lead and manage the 24/7 Malaysia Customer Service team, ensuring the delivery of consistent, high-quality customer service across all shifts.  You will be responsible for team performance, workforce planning, operational efficiency and service quality. You will also work closely with internal stakeholders, including Product, Operations, Compliance and other relevant teams, to identify recurring customer issues and drive improvements to products, services and customer experience based on customer feedback.  The successful candidate will be a strong people leader who can build a high-performing team, manage a 24/7 operation and ensure service levels and customer experience standards are consistently achieved.   Key Responsibilities     Lead and manage the 24/7 Malaysia Customer Service team, including Customer Service Officers and Shift Leads.  Set performance expectations and drive achievement of KPIs, SLAs, CSAT and service-quality targets.  Coach and develop Shift Leads and team members through regular performance reviews and development discussions.  Manage workforce planning and shift scheduling to ensure adequate 24/7 coverage.  Monitor operational performance and use data/MIS to identify trends, performance gaps and improvement opportunities.  Oversee customer escalations, complaints and operational incidents, ensuring timely resolution and appropriate escalation.  Work with Product, Operations, Compliance and other stakeholders to address recurring customer issues and improve processes.  Partner with HR on recruitment, onboarding, performance management and future headcount planning.  Drive a positive, accountable and high-performing team culture.     Requirements     4–5 years of experience in Customer Support / Customer Service management, preferably within a brokerage, securities, fintech, financial-services or other regulated environment.  Experience managing or supporting a 24/7 Customer Support operation is strongly preferred.  Proven track record of meeting or exceeding team KPIs, SLAs and customer-service performance.  Strong people-management, coaching and performance-management skills.  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using operational data/MIS to drive improvements.  Experience in workforce planning, scheduling and resource management is an advantage.  Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills.  Fluent in English and Mandarin; Bahasa Melayu is an added advantage.  Willing to support the 24/7 operation, including occasional night shifts, weekends or public holidays when required.

Du är bekväm med att fatta beslut, ställa krav och hantera svåra samtal när det behövs. Du tar stort ägarskap, arbetar målinriktat och trivs i en vardag med tempo, förändring och ansvar. title: Avdelingsleder Kundesenter Innlandet
description: Menneskene er selve DNA-et i DNB. Siden 1822 har kloke hoder jobbet sammen for å finne de beste løsningene for kundene våre. I dag er DNB mye mer enn Norges største bank – vi er en teknologidrevet finansinstitusjon som på stadig nye måter knytter mennesker og ideer til kunnskap og kapital.    Mangfoldig er noe vi er, og inkluderende er noe vi hver dag velger å være. Vi gir rom for deg og dine tanker, og vi lover å gjøre vårt aller beste for at du skal føle deg hjemme hos oss. En jobb i Norges største finanskonsern byr på faglige utfordringer i et spennende arbeidsmiljø med mange muligheter. Gjennom ansatte med ulik kompetanse og bakgrunn kan vi sammen skape en attraktiv og fleksibel organisasjon, tilrettelagt for utvikling og endring.    Liker du å få folk til å lykkes – og vil lede et team som skaper fantastiske kundeopplevelser?   Hos oss i Kundesenter Personmarked (PM) er målet enkelt: 100 % gode kundeopplevelser i hvert møte og hver samtale. Nå ser vi etter en avdelingsleder som gleder seg til å lede dyktige rådgivere – og som selv trigges av høyt tempo, endring og resultater.   Hva går jobben ut på?   Som  avdelingsleder  i Kundesenter Innlandet blir du en synlig og tydelig leder. Du har ansvaret for at avdelingen leverer både topp kundeopplevelser og bankens mål – og at folka dine har det gøy på jobb. Det betyr at du:    Leder, utvikler og motiverer rådgiverteamet ditt i hverdagen  Følger opp resultater og skaper retning gjennom god kommunikasjon  Bidrar aktivt i ledergruppen og tenker helhetlig for hele lokasjonen  Driver endringsprosesser og tar initiativ til forbedringer  Har fokus på utvikling av både mennesker og kultur     Du blir en del av et engasjert lederteam som samarbeider tett og heier hverandre frem.   Hvem er du?   Vi tror du lykkes hos oss dersom du:    Har erfaring fra ledelse, coaching og kunderettet arbeid  Trives med ansvar for både resultater og mennesker  Har sterke kommunikasjonsevner og bygger tillit  Har relevant høyere utdanning – men lang, relevant erfaring kan kompensere  Har det lille ekstra engasjementet som smitter over på andre      Hvorfor DNB og Kundesenter PM?   Du blir en del av Norges største bank og et miljø i utvikling – med tydelig satsing på kundeopplevelser, digitalisering og kompetanse. Vi tilbyr solide utviklingsmuligheter, gode betingelser og en kultur der vi løfter frem folk.   Praktisk informasjon     Stillingssted: Gjøvik  Søknadsfrist: 5. oktober  Kontaktperson: Tone Mari Malterud-Lien, tlf. +47 466 31 412, e-post: tone.mari.malterud-lien@dnb.no      Hos oss skal du kunne være deg selv.   Vi er opptatt av å bygge team med ulik erfaring og perspektiver, fordi det gir bedre løsninger. Det viktigste for oss er hva du kan bidra med – ikke hvem du er på papiret.   I søknadsprosessen trenger du kun å laste opp din CV og svare kort på noen stillingsrelaterte spørsmål. Søknadsbrev er ikke et krav, men du kan selvfølgelig laste det opp som et vedlegg om du ønsker.    Vi gjennomfører bakgrunnssjekk

Engage with at-risk customers and develop prescriptive strategies to mitigate potential churn and improve retention.  Communicate renewal risk clearly, take the lead in developing resolution strategies, and escalate wherever appropriate. Maintain and report an accurate 90–120-day rolling forecast of renewals and proactively manage risks and opportunities within the forecast.  Track and contribute to key business outcomes, including Renewal Rate, Net Retention Rate (NRR), renewal attainment, and expansion. Business-level fluency in Japanese and English.   2–5 years of experience in customer-facing SaaS roles, such as software/subscription renewals, account management, sales, customer success, or Deal Desk, with experience managing commercial conversations and customer relationships.

title: Responsable Customer Success & Communauté (H/F)
description: Rattachement :  Julien, l’un des fondateurs. Tu travailles en autonomie complète sur ton périmètre, en lien direct avec l'équipe produit. Pas de middle management, tu es responsable de tes livrables et tu rends compte directement aux fondateurs.   Interfaces principales :  Tu travailles en lien direct avec les équipes Produit, Tech, Marketing et Sales.   Ton rôle :  Tu es la voix de nos utilisateurs. Chez Liberty Rider, le service client n'est pas un centre de coûts : c'est le lien direct entre 2 millions de motards et l'équipe qui construit l'app. Notre réputation de bienveillance et de réactivité s'est bâtie là-dessus, et c'est toi qui la portes.   Tes Missions   Ton poste s'articule autour de deux moitiés qui se nourrissent l'une de l'autre : garantir une expérience sans friction sur l'app, et faire grandir la Tribu.   Service client & qualité produit (~60 %) :     Tu pilotes notre agent IA de première ligne : tu entraînes ses réponses, tu analyses ce qu'il ne résout pas, tu fais monter le taux de résolution automatique et le NPS.  Tu prends en main les cas que l'IA ne peut pas traiter — les situations sensibles, les motards qui viennent de chuter, les demandes complexes — avec la précision et l'humanité qu'ils méritent.  Tu fais vivre le centre d'aide : nouveaux contenus, mise à jour à chaque release, base de connaissance de l'IA.  Tu testes chaque version de l'app avant sa mise en production, tu qualifies les bugs remontés par les utilisateurs et tu participes aux sprints de l'équipe tech.  Tu optimises les process, outils et automatisations pour que le temps passé sur le traitement diminue, et que le temps passé avec les utilisateurs augmente.     Communauté & projets fédérateurs (~40 %) :     Tu conçois et pilotes des projets qui rassemblent la Tribu : programme de bêta-testeurs, ambassadeurs, challenges, contenus co-créés avec les motards.  Tu vas à leur rencontre : salons, rassemblements, sorties moto, événements que tu organises ou auxquels tu représentes Liberty Rider.  Tu fais remonter ce que les motards vivent, demandent et proposent — de façon structurée, chiffrée — vers le produit, la tech et le marketing.  Tu participes aux réunions marketing pour apporter des idées d'animation, de fidélisation et de prise de parole nourries par ta connaissance du terrain.     POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ?   Une mission qui a du sens : Chez Liberty Rider, ton travail a un impact concret : contribuer à sauver des vies et améliorer la sécurité des motards.   Un rôle clé et autonome   Directement rattaché·e à Julien, co-fondateur, tu portes la relation utilisateurs de bout en bout : satisfaction, rétention et animation de la communauté des ambassadeurs.   Une communauté engagée à faire grandir   Tu prends la main sur le programme Ambassadeurs : recruter, animer, faire vivre un réseau de motards qui portent la marque bien au-delà de l'application.   Un environnement agile et responsabilisant   Équipe à taille humaine, circuits courts, capacité

title: Customer Success Manager

Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. title: Go to market-manager
description: Om rollen   Vi söker en Go to market-manager som vill vara med och utveckla hur vi skapar värde för våra kunder genom vår plattform.     Det här är en bred och hands-on roll i skärningspunkten mellan produkt, kundutveckling och operations. Du kommer att arbeta nära den svenska verksamheten och våra kunder för att identifiera nya tillväxtmöjligheter, förstå verksamhetens behov och säkerställa att vår produkt och våra arbetssätt utvecklas i rätt riktning.     Du kommer också att fungera som en viktig länk mellan den svenska organisationen och våra produkt- och utvecklingsteam. Det innebär att du behöver kunna gå från ett kommersiellt eller operationellt problem till analys, hypotes och tydlig kravställning – och därefter driva arbetet hela vägen till implementering och uppföljning.     Rollen passar dig som trivs i en snabbrörlig miljö där alla svar inte finns från början. Du kombinerar strategisk och analytisk höjd med ett starkt driv och ägandeskap för att få saker att hända.      Ditt ansvar   I rollen kommer du bland annat att:       Utveckla våra kunder genom plattformen.  Arbeta tillsammans med den kommersiella organisationen för att identifiera hur produktfunktionalitet och nya arbetssätt kan öka kundernas användning, effektivitet och värde av plattformen.   Vara länken mellan verksamhet och produkt/tech.  Fånga upp och prioritera behov från kunder och den svenska verksamheten, omsätta dem till business cases och prioriteringar för den svenska marknaden.   Leda lansering och implementation av nya funktioner.  Ansvara för den svenska utrullningen av nya produkter och funktioner – från planering och stakeholder alignment till lansering, implementering och uppföljning.   Driva initiativ från idé till resultat.  Projektleda initiativ tillsammans med Account Management och Sales och säkerställa att de omsätts till faktisk nyttja för verksamheten.   Arbeta datadrivet.  Analysera resultat, utfall och användardata, formulera hypoteser, definiera relevanta KPI:er och använda resultaten för att prioritera och utveckla våra initiativ.   Kommunicera rekommendationer och skapa alignment.  Strukturera komplexa frågeställningar och presentera tydliga rekommendationer, business cases och beslutsunderlag för såväl interna stakeholders som kunder.       Vem vi söker   Vi tror att du har:      4–6+ års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet, exempelvis från management consulting, Strategy & Operations, Business Operations, Commercial Operations inom tech eller en liknande roll.  Erfarenhet av att leda strategiska, kommersiella eller operationella projekt och av att driva initiativ från analys och idé till implementering.  Stark analytisk problemlösningsförmåga och vana att arbeta datadrivet.  Erfarenhet av att arbeta tvärfunktionellt, gärna nära både kommersiella team och produkt-/utvecklingsorganisationer.  Förmåga att ta fram och presentera tydliga beslutsunderlag och rekommendationer.  Erfarenhet från en snabbväxande eller snabbrörlig organisation.  Relevant

title: Manager:in Customer Success // Customer Support (German Speaking)
description: Nur Vollzeit möglich – Standort Wien (AT)     Unterstütze uns als Customer Sucess Manager:in in Wien!    Standort: Wien (AT) | Gehalt: Ab EUR € 3.155,- Brutto/Monat (KV), Überzahlung möglich     Warum du?    Du brennst für innovative Technologie und dafür, sie für andere Menschen zugänglich(er) zu machen? Wir suchen eine kommunikationsstarke und lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit, die den Umgang mit Menschen liebt und die Digitalisierung der Bauindustrie durch unsere Software aktiv mitgestalten möchte.    Wer sind wir?    Die Idee für reebuild entstand direkt auf der Baustelle: Bauleiter:innen verbringen zum Teil mehrere Stunden täglich mit Verwaltungsaufgaben wie Rechnungsprüfung, Bestellabgleich oder dem Erstellen von Aufmaßblättern – und diese Stunden fließen dann nicht mehr in die Bauprojekte, auf die es eigentlich ankommt.   Das wollten wir ändern, und haben daher eine KI entwickelt, die den administrativen Aufwand für Bauunternehmen und Projektentwickler:innen um bis zu 75 % reduziert.   Da es jedoch nur mit einem motivierten Team möglich ist, unsere Software ständig weiter zu optimieren, sind wir aktuell auf der Suche nach neuen ambitionierten Kolleg:innen.  Aufgaben   Deine Aufgaben    Als Manager:in in der Kund:innenbetreuung bei reebuild bist du die zentrale Anlaufstelle für unsere B2B-Kund:innen (Bauunternehmen und Projektentwickler:innen) und fungierst gleichzeitig als Schnittstelle für das gesamte Customer-Success-Team. Deine Mission: Sicherzustellen, dass unsere Kund:innen unsere Plattform optimal verstehen und ihr Feedback so dokumentiert wird, dass wir es zur Optimierung unserer Software ideal verwenden können. So spielst du eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Begleitung unserer Kund:innen und bist gleichzeitig stellvertretend für sie dabei, wenn es darum geht, neuen Features den letzten Feinschliff zu verpassen und das perfekte Produkt zu entwickeln.   Dein Aufgabenbereich gliedert sich daher in zwei Bereiche:    1. Software-Support:  Unterstützung unserer Kund:innen bei der Anwendung unserer Software mithilfe von E-Mail, Telefon und Videocall sowie schnelle und kompetente Hilfestellung bei ihren Herausforderungen. Deine Offenheit, Spontanität und Lösungsorientierung sind dabei essenziell.    2. Produktentwicklung:  Strukturierte Dokumentation von Kund:innenanfragen und Weiterleitung von wertvollen Verbesserungsvorschlägen direkt an unser Produkt- und Entwicklungsteam.  Qualifikation   Dein Profil:    Eine oder mehrere dieser Punkte treffen auf dich zu:      Du besitzt 1-2 Jahre Erfahrung in der Kundenbetreuung  – Idealerweise hast du schon einmal im Customer Support oder Customer Success in der Software-Branche gearbeitet    Du bist neugierig  und willst verstehen, wie Dinge funktionieren    Du besitzt Kenntnisse der Bauwirtschaft  – z. B. durch Erfahrung in der kaufmännischen Bauabwicklung, im technischen Innendienst oder im Bereich Architektur    Du hast eine Affinität zu Software und digitalen Lösungen  und findest dich in neuen

title: Service Operations Center (SOC) Manager
description: Join Telavox as a Service Operations Support Manager 🌎   We are looking for a talented and driven Service Operations Center (SOC) Manager to join our team. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys technical problem-solving, leadership, and providing top-notch customer support in the telecom and UCaaS industry. If you're excited about leading a support team solving complex technical challenges and contributing to a fast-growing, innovative company, we’d love to hear from you!   About The Job   As a Service Operations Center Manager at Telavox, you will be responsible for leading a team that provides second-level technical support to our operator clients. The team is based in Malmö, but our clients are around the world. You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure customers have a seamless experience with our software products and services.   A Typical Day In This Role Involves     Team leadership and coordination: Managing and guiding a team of support engineers, ensuring high-quality service delivery through various channels like tickets, phone, email, and chat.  On-call duty management: Organizing and overseeing the team’s on-call schedule, ensuring proper coverage during after-hours support. Except for leading a team of Tech Support Engineers, the team includes an Incident Manager responsible for incident management and its ways of working.  Technical issue resolution: Diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving escalated issues while maintaining a customer-focused mindset.  Stakeholder & Service Provider collaboration: Build strong relationships across support, product, customer operations, and larger Service Providers to resolve issues, improve processes, and turn feedback into action.  Reporting: Maintaining, improving, and automating our customer reporting on SLA and Service Operations status.  SLA management: Monitoring team performance to ensure service-level agreements (SLAs) are met, escalating incidents as needed, and continuously improving the support process.    This role is based in our Malmö office, where you’ll join a collaborative and innovative work environment and have opportunities to lead and influence our growing global support operations.   About You   We’re looking for a leader with a minimum of 3-5 years of leadership experience in technical support or customer service, ideally within the software or telecom industry. You thrive in a leadership role, have a strong grasp of technical troubleshooting, and are dedicated to delivering exceptional customer satisfaction. You thrive at fostering team spirit and building a positive, collaborative culture that motivates your team to perform at their best.   Competencies     Experience in a technical support role, with at least 3-5 years of team leadership experience.  Experience managing on-call rotations and ensuring 24/7 coverage, including leading incident management operations.  Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-focused mindse

Norex Selected Brands Oy on vuonna 1981 perustettu suomalainen perheyritys ja yksi Suomen suurimmista viinien ja väkevien alkoholijuomien maahantuojista. Norex kasvaa ja kehittää liiketoimintaansa aktiivisesti myös nykyisten tuotekategorioidensa ulkopuolelle. Samalla hän tuo Norexille uutta FMCG- ja juomakategorioiden osaamista, joka auttaa meitä rakentamaan tulevaisuuden kasvua ja avaamaan uusia liiketoimintamahdollisuuksia.      Mitä tehtävässä pääset tekemään?      Sales Managerina vastaat Travel Retail / Duty Free -asiakkuuksiemme kehittämisestä ja kasvatat liiketoimintaa sekä nykyisten että uusien asiakkaiden kanssa. Työskentelet itsenäisesti asiakkaiden, kansainvälisten päämiesten sekä Norexin oman myynti- ja tuotepäällikköorganisaation kanssa. Roolin tarkkaa sisältöä ja vastuualueiden painotuksia voidaan rakentaa myös kokemuksesi ja vahvuuksiesi ympärille.      Mitä odotamme sinulta?      Etsimme ennen kaikkea kaupallista tekijää, jolla on kokemusta FMCG-liiketoiminnasta ja näyttöä itsenäisestä asiakasvastuusta. Lumera tilbyr løsninger som er langsiktig bærekraftige med mål om å automatisere og digitalisere ulike forretningsprosesser og muliggjøre innovativ forretningsutvikling for våre kunder. I dag er vi ca. 600 ansatte og har kontorer i Stockholm, Umeå, Oslo, London, Bristol, Edinburgh, Utrecht, Hanoi, Mumbai og Pune.     Lumera søker en  applikasjonskonsulent  til vårt Oslo-kontor. Rollen er en nøkkelposisjon i grensesnittet mellom kunde, forretning og teknologi. Du vil være bindeleddet mellom våre systemer og kundens behov, og sørge for at våre løsninger fungerer optimalt og skaper verdi i kundens virksomhet.     Våre egenutviklede systemer er bygget i .NET og kjøres som sky-basert løsning i Azure eller private cloud. Systemet inneholder full funksjonalitet for administrasjon av pensjon, livsforsikringer og sparing. Rollen innebærer også å gi rådgivning basert på din innsikt i både kundens virksomhet og Lumeras produktportefølje, samt å delta aktivt i faste kundeforum.      Hvem er du?   Vi ser etter deg som motiveres av komplekse utfordringer og som liker å finne de mest bærekraftige, langsiktige løsningene i samarbeid med andre. Du bygger gode og tillitsfulle relasjoner til både kunder og kolleger, og kommuniserer tydelig og strukturert. Du har en naturlig drivkraft og tar stolthet i det du leverer.      Vi tror du har:    Høyere utdanning innen IT eller teknologi  Gjerne nyutdannet eller med noen års erfaring som systemspesialist, supportkonsulent eller annen rolle som binder kunder, forretning og teknologi sammen  God IT-teknisk forståelse og evne til å raskt sette seg inn i nye systemer  Du har god muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne, både på norsk og engelsk, samt gode kommunikasjonsevner. Dyktige og svært hjelpsomme kolleger preget av høy kompetanse, nysgjerrighet og løsningsfokus  Utfordrende og variert arbeid innen et komplekst og samfunnsviktig område  Mulighet til å utvikle deg, vokse og ta ansvar tidlig  Kontor midt i Oslo sentrum  Konkurransedyktig lønn, samt gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger  Trivsel og godt arbeidsmiljø      For mer informasjon, ta kontakt med Arnt Molvig på telefon  934 40 805  i Compass Human Resources. Työsuhteen alussa työskentelemme toimistolla sujuvan perehdytyksen varmistamiseksi. Osaamisen karttuessa sinulla on myös mahdollisuus tehdä töitä etänä yhteisiä pelisääntöjä noudattaen. Elisalla on käytössä hybridityön malli, jonka mukaan työskentelemme toimistolla keskimäärin kolmena päivänä viikossa.   💰Tehtävässä varmistat osaltasi asiakaspalvelumme myynnillistä onnistumista, ja me myös palkitsemme sinua onnistumisista ja itsesi ylittämisestä!  Pohjapalkkasi määräytyy ICT-alan TES:n mukaan (2357   €/kk), minkä lisäksi tarjoamme houkuttelevan kannustemallin, jossa ansaintamahdollisuudet ovat aidosti omissa käsissäsi. Lisäansiot vaihtelevat tyypillisesti muutamista sadoista aina useisiin tuhansiin euroihin kuukaudessa!    Mitä toivomme sinulta?   Me uskomme, että asiakaskohtaamisten ammattilaiseksi kasvetaan oppien ja kokemuksen kautta. Emme siis odota sinun olevan valmis ammattilainen – innostus ja motivaatio vievät pitkälle! title: Delivery Specialist / Senior Delivery Specialist
description: About The Role   As a Delivery Specialist at Avarda, you will play a key role in delivering successful payment solutions to our merchants across the Nordics and supporting their growth journey toward new markets. You will own and drive merchant implementations from planning to successful go-live, acting as the bridge between our merchants and internal teams across Product, IT, Development, Operations, and Commercial.  The role combines project management, implementation consulting, technical integration coordination, and service management. You will work primarily with mid-sized online retailers, while also supporting some of our most important strategic merchants after launch — helping them integrate Avarda's solutions, optimize their payment experience, and ensure long-term success. You will manage multiple implementation projects simultaneously alongside these ongoing relationships - ideal for someone who enjoys taking ownership, solving complex challenges, and working in a fast-paced fintech environment where you can make a direct impact.    Key Responsibilities      Lead end-to-end merchant onboarding and implementation projects, typically running over several months  Manage multiple merchant implementations simultaneously while maintaining high quality, transparency, and delivery predictability  Act as the main delivery partner for merchants, ensuring excellent communication and a smooth implementation experience  Coordinate collaboration between merchants and internal teams, including Product, IT, Development, Operations, Commercial, and other stakeholders  Support technical implementation activities, including API integrations, troubleshooting, testing, and release coordination  Translate merchant business requirements into actionable tasks for technical and operational teams  Proactively manage delivery risks, dependencies, and blockers to ensure successful and timely delivery  Ensure a smooth transition from implementation to ongoing service management, then support strategic merchants with continuous improvements that sustain high satisfaction and strong partnerships  Contribute to improving implementation processes, tools, documentation, and ways of working, sharing insights from merchant interactions to support product and operational development     We are hiring at both the Delivery Specialist and Senior Delivery Specialist level.  The core role is the same — we set the level, scope, and mentoring responsibilities based on your experience, so we encourage you to apply whether you are building your delivery career or bringing a track record of leading complex implementations.  At the Senior level, you will also  take the lead on our most strategic and complex merchant implementations, act as a point of escalation for delivery challenges, and help mentor colleagues and shape how the team works.   Qualifications And Experience     Must-haves      2+ years (Delivery Specialist) or 5+ years (Senior Delivery Specialist) of experience

title: Startup Account Manager

title: Generalist:in Customer Success // Customer Support (German Speaking)
description: Teilzeit und Vollzeit möglich – Standort Wien (AT)     Werde als Junior Customer Success Generalist:in Teil unseres revolutionierenden Teams!    Standort: Wien (AT) | Gehalt: Ab EUR 2.236,- Brutto/Monat (KV), Überzahlung möglich     Warum du?    Du bist neugierig, geduldig und hilfsbereit – mit einer echten „Deine Probleme sind auch meine"-Mentalität. Du besitzt Empathie und kannst Probleme nicht nur nachvollziehen, sondern denkst konsequent in Lösungen. Du interessierst dich ehrlich für die Herausforderungen unserer Kund:innen und sprichst ihre Sprache. Und wenn's drauf ankommt, beißt du dich durch – mit Charme. 😉    Wer sind wir?    Die Idee für reebuild entstand direkt auf der Baustelle: Bauleiter:innen verbringen zum Teil mehrere Stunden täglich mit Verwaltungsaufgaben wie Rechnungsprüfung, Bestellabgleich oder dem Erstellen von Aufmaßblättern – und diese Stunden fließen dann nicht mehr in die Bauprojekte, auf die es eigentlich ankommt.   Das wollten wir ändern, und haben daher eine KI entwickelt, die den administrativen Aufwand für Bauunternehmen und Projektentwickler:innen um bis zu 75 % reduziert.   Da es jedoch nur mit einem motivierten Team möglich ist, unsere Software ständig weiter zu optimieren, sind wir aktuell auf der Suche nach neuen ambitionierten Kolleg:innen.  Aufgaben   Deine Aufgaben:    Als Junior Customer Success Generalist:in bei reebuild bist du die zentrale Anlaufstelle für unsere B2B-Kund:innen – Bauunternehmen und Projektentwickler:innen. Deine Mission: Sicherstellen, dass unsere KI-gestützte Software optimal genutzt wird und Fragen schnell, kompetent und nachhaltig gelöst werden. Du begleitest unsere Kund:innen vom Erstkontakt bis zur vollumfänglichen Nutzung unserer Plattform, und erklärst Abläufe geduldig bis zum letzten Klick.      Software-Support (Help-Desk):  Du unterstützt unsere Kund:innen per E-Mail, Telefon und Videocall bei der Anwendung unserer Software und reagierst auf ihre Anforderungen direkt und lösungsorientiert.    Wissensmanagement:  Du vermittelst Kund:innen das nötige Wissen, um souverän mit unserem Tool umzugehen – von der Einführung bis zur eigenständigen Nutzung.    Produktfeedback:  Du hörst genau hin, erkennst Muster in den Rückmeldungen deiner Kund:innen und gibst dieses Feedback direkt an die Produktentwicklung weiter.    Überblick behalten:  Auch wenn es mal stressig wird, weißt du, welche Herausforderungen gerade bei deinen Kund:innen liegen – und priorisierst richtig.    Du bringst eigene Ideen ein:  Du arbeitest gründlich und weißt genau, wenn du bei deinen Kolleg:innen Informationen einholen musst, hältst dich aber auch nicht zurück, wenn es um das Einbringen eigener Ideen geht.    Qualifikation   Dein Profil:    Eine oder mehrere dieser Punkte treffen auf dich zu:      Du besitzt ein Gespür oder bereits erste gute Erfahrungen mit der Kundenbetreuung  – Idealerweise hast du schon einmal im Customer Support oder Customer Success gearbeitet    Du bist neugierig  und willst verstehen

title: Lead Account Management
description: Riyadh Air (RX), headquartered in the Saudi Capital, is the new national airline that’s shaping the future of flying. It seeks to lead the aviation industry by transforming Saudi Arabia into a global aviation and trade hub – a digitally native airline that will connect the kingdom to more than 100 destinations.   About The Role   Are you ready to grow high-value agency partnerships and make us the first choice across the Central Province travel trade market?  This role is central to developing an assigned portfolio of travel management companies, online travel agencies, and travel agencies across the Central Province. It combines field-based relationship management with responsive day-to-day commercial support that drives loyalty, conversion, and revenue.  A core part of the role is owning your agency portfolio through structured visit plans, production targets, and regular performance reviews. Success depends on building strong relationships that strengthen account performance and uncover new sources of volume.  Working closely with agency partners, the role focuses on supporting daily requests related to bookings, waivers within policy, servicing escalations, and New Distribution Capability (NDC) content issues. You will also manage group demand from quotation and negotiation through to follow-up and materialization.  With responsibility for commercial growth, this position supports the development of labor movement and leisure segments within the portfolio. It also includes delivering product, network, and systems training, while representing us at roadshows and trade events.  You can expect to track production against incentive and campaign targets, build recovery plans for underperforming accounts, and provide weekly reporting on visits, pipeline activity, competitor movements, and issues requiring escalation.  This is your chance to build powerful trade partnerships, unlock commercial growth, and help shape how travelers across the Central Province connect with us.   About You   Degree qualified, you will demonstrate a minimum of 5 years of sales experience with an airline or travel agency, including direct agency account management.  You will bring strong knowledge of fares, ticketing, group handling, and NDC, along with established relationships in the Central Province agency market, commercial numeracy, consultative selling skills, and the ability to manage a field-based account portfolio with pace, resilience, and professionalism.  This is your opportunity to shape the future of air travel. Bring your best and show us why you can own this position within Riyadh Air.  Please submit your application by clicking on the Apply button. Our Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing applications shortly.

title: APAC Account Operations Director - Penang
description: About The Role   As a CBRE Account Management Director, you will assist with the oversight of the department responsible for delivering all client commitments.  This is part of the Operations Management job functions. They are responsible for coordinating staff functions and operations that support the organization’s goals and strategies.   What You’ll Do     Provide formal supervision to employees. Monitor the training and development of staff. Conduct performance evaluations and coaching. Oversee the recruiting and hiring of new employees.  Coordinate and manage the team's daily activities. Establish work schedules, assign tasks, and cross-train staff. Set and track staff and department deadlines. Mentor and coach as needed.  Interact and consult with clients to understand business needs. Coordinate the resources needed to service projects, build strategic operational plans, and balance the expectations of clients with the execution of work.  Manage several clients simultaneously, while serving as a point of contact for systems and processes for new and current projects.  Oversee the management of sales and relationships with key customers. Ensure proper services and enhancements are being carried out. Troubleshoot and solve conflicts.  Direct the project process. This includes developing project plans, creating a project team, and managing timeframes and performance.  Verify the timely and successful delivery of solutions according to client needs and objectives as well as contract specifics.  Consult with internal and client teams to define project requirements, investigating various approaches to attain end results.  Apply a robust knowledge of multiple disciplines, the business, and key drivers which impact departmental and cross-functional performance.  Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE values. Persuade managers and other colleagues to take action while being guided by the organization's functional business plans. Negotiate with external partners, vendors, and customers of divergent interests to reach a common goal.  Identify and solve multi-dimensional, complex, operational, and organizational problems leveraging the appropriate resources within or outside the department.  Significantly improves and changes existing methods, processes, and standards within job discipline.     What You’ll Need     Bachelor's Degree preferred with 8-12 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered.  Experience in the areas of staffing, selection, training, development, coaching, mentoring, measuring, appraising, and rewarding performance and retention is preferred.  Ability to lead the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations, and handle problems.

Dans un contexte de transformation de son organisation et d’évolution de ses pratiques, l’entreprise souhaite renforcer son pilotage de la relation client et recrute son futur  Directeur de la relation client (Femme/Homme). Vous pilotez l'ensemble du parcours client à partir de la phase de déploiement et supervisez les différentes composantes du delivery : gestion de projets clients, onboarding, formation des utilisateurs et support métier ou technique.  Votre principal enjeu consiste à  faire évoluer en profondeur l'organisation de la relation client et les pratiques de delivery , dans un contexte marqué par le développement de nouvelles offres et la transformation des attentes clients. title: Head of Customer Success
description: Head of Customer Success — Coaching en ligne (perte de poids)    Remote · Temps plein · Francophone · Freelance       Le business en deux minutes   Nous opérons un programme de coaching en ligne dédié à la perte de poids pour femme, porté par une figure connue de son audience sur les réseaux (+2M Followers).  Un accompagnement de 3 mois construit sur trois piliers : sport, nutrition et mindset   Le nom de la marque est communiqué lors du premier échange.      Quelques repères :   Plus de 2 000 femmes accompagnées depuis le lancement  Environ 240 clientes actives en permanence  Environ 70 nouvelles clientes par mois  Une équipe structurée : coachs, setting, closing, COO, CTO  Une croissance continue      Ce n'est pas un projet lancé il y a six mois. C'est une structure qui tourne, qui délivre depuis +2 ans, et qui a maintenant besoin de quelqu'un pour faire progresser la partie post-vente.      Pourquoi ce poste existe   Aujourd'hui, toute notre équipe travaille sur ce qui se passe  avant  la vente : générer des leads, remplir les agendas, closer. Ça fonctionne.  Ce qui se passe  après  la vente n'appartient à personne. Nos clientes sont bien accompagnées, mais personne ne pilote la satisfaction, personne n'optimise le renouvellement, personne n'exploite notre base de +2 000 anciennes clientes, personne ne construit de programme de parrainage.  Ce sont des axes totalement inexploités.      Ce que tu piloteras    Le renouvellement.  Environ 17 % de nos clientes prolongent leur accompagnement à la fin des 3 mois. Tu es responsable de faire progresser ce chiffre : proposition, timing, argumentaire, price point, homogénéité entre les coachs.   La croissance par la base clientes.  Parrainage, affiliation, réactivation des anciennes clientes. Tout ce chiffre est aujourd'hui à zéro parce que rien n'existe. Tu construis, tu testes, tu pilotes.   Les remboursements.  Tu traites chaque demande, tu décides, et surtout tu fais baisser le nombre de clientes qui en arrivent là. Ça passe par comprendre les causes racines et corriger en amont.   La preuve client.  Avant/après exploitables, témoignages, satisfaction mesurée, avis publics. Notre matériel de preuve est aujourd'hui produit de façon artisanale et largement inexploitable en marketing. Tu en fais un processus.   La qualité de délivrance.  Tu manages notre Head Coach et, à travers elle, l'équipe de coachs. Tu es garant du niveau d'accompagnement et de son évolution.   Le produit.  Tu proposes les évolutions de l'offre à partir de ce que te disent les données et les clientes.      Comment on mesure ton impact    Taux de renouvellement  Clientes entrées par parrainage et par réactivation  Taux de demandes de remboursement  Score de satisfaction  Nombre d'avant/après exploitables produits  Taux de clientes menant leur parcours à terme   Certains de ces indicateurs ne sont pas encore mesurés. Les mettre en place fait partie de tes premiers travaux.  On te donne le périmètre, l'accès aux données et la mai

title: Head of Business Center Denmark
location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: Vil du stå i spidsen for at bygge fremtidens Business Center Denmark?   Hvad sker der, når man samler stærke mennesker, forskellige kulturer og store ambitioner i én fælles organisation? Det er præcis den rejse, som vi er på.  Business Center Denmark er et centralt powerhouse i Commercial med ansvar for salg, service og fastholdelse af vores erhvervskunder. Vi har allerede skabt meget, men vi er ikke færdige.  Nu leder vi efter en ny Head of Business Center Denmark, som har lyst til at bygge videre på fundamentet, samle organisationen og sætte retningen for det næste kapitel.   Om rollen   Du får en central rolle i udviklingen af Business Center Denmark. Du får ansvaret for omkring 34 forsikringsrådgivere, tre teamledere og en organisation, hvor vi hver dag skal levere stærke kundeoplevelser, skabe kommercielle resultater og samtidig fortsætte vores udvikling. Din opgave bliver ikke blot at sikre, at organisationen fungerer. Du skal være med til at definere, hvordan vi arbejder, leder og skaber resultater fremover.  Vi er i gang med at samle kulturer, systemer og arbejdsformer efter integrationen mellem If og Topdanmark. Vi er kommet langt, men vi er ikke i mål. Dit lederskab, dine idéer og dit aftryk bliver afgørende for, hvordan vi lykkes som én organisation. Derfor får du en unik mulighed for at sætte dit præg på både kultur, performance og fremtidens måde at arbejde på.  Du bliver en del af den nordiske ledergruppe sammen med de øvrige nationale Head of Business Centers i Norden og Head of Competence & Quality development. Her repræsenterer du Danmark og er med til at forme udviklingen af Business Center på tværs af Norden. Du får dermed indflydelse på udviklingen på tværs af lande, samtidigt med at du får et tydeligt dansk ansvar, hvor du kommer tæt på både mennesker, kunder og forretning.  Som ansvarlig for Business Center Denmark vil du arbejde tæt sammen med Head of Nordic Business Center, som fungerer som sparringspartner, udfordrer dine perspektiver og aktivt understøtter, at du og din ledergruppe har de bedste forudsætninger for at lykkes. Vi tror på, at de stærkeste resultater skabes gennem tydelig retning, tillid og et stærkt samarbejde, hvor åbenhed, nysgerrighed og modet til at udfordre det eksisterende er en naturlig del af hverdagen. description: French Customer Success [Coach Terminator]  🇫🇷 🥐      Sobre nosotros y nuestra cultura [The Walcu way]:   Somos una start-up tecnológica que vende software as a service (SaaS) a concesionarios y hemos revolucionado con nuestro CRM la forma en que éstos venden coches. En 8 años ya somos unos 50 empleados y facturamos €8M anuales en ventas de software a empresas del automóvil tanto en Europa como Latinoamérica y quién sabe donde más...     Pero eso no es lo importante.     Lo importante es cómo trabajamos.     En Walcu:   Somos un equipo joven (sí, la media está por debajo de los 30), con mucha energía y pocas ganas de hacer las cosas a medias.  Nos tomamos el trabajo en serio, pero no a nosotros mismos  Decimos las cosas como son (aunque incomode)  Valoramos el criterio por encima de seguir procesos  Y creemos que el impacto real está en hacer que otros mejoren, no en hacer el trabajo por ellos   No somos para todo el mundo. Y eso está bien.      Sobre ti:       Eres francés/a (o tienes el francés como idioma nativo) y puedes trabajar en español. Estás en Madrid o te vienes.  Entiendes rápido cómo funcionan los negocios y las personas  Sabes comunicar con claridad, precisión y criterio  No evitas las conversaciones difíciles  Detectas problemas antes de que sean un problema  Y tienes el impulso natural de mejorar lo que tocas      Vamos, eres la repanocha.      ¿Cómo será tu día a día como Customer Coach?   Sí, hemos retirado el término Customer Success y lo hemos rebrandeado como Customer Coach porque el verdadero éxito no consiste en ayudar a los clientes a hacer el trabajo. Se trata de ayudarles a aprender a hacer el trabajo. No hacemos el trabajo para los clientes.  Enseñamos a los clientes a hacer el trabajo por sí mismos.      Qué harás (de verdad):      Serás responsable de que tus clientes del mercado francés usen Walcu bien y obtengan resultados reales.      Construirás relaciones de confianza (de las que permiten decir cosas incómodas)  Liderararás cuentas y ser el punto de referencia del cliente  Entrenarás, retarás y acompañarás al cliente para que saque el máximo partido a Walcu y lo integre en su operativa real.  Entenderás su negocio, sus objetivos y sus retos para convertir la herramienta en impacto tangible.  Identificarás oportunidades de evolución en la cuenta, proponiendo ampliaciones que generen impacto real. Para nosotros el éxito no es vender más licencias, sino que el cliente sienta Walcu como su propio CRM.  Monitorizarás la salud de la relación (uso, engagement, riesgo de churn) y actuarás antes de que haya problemas.  Trasladarás al equipo de Producto feedback accionable y defenderás la voz del cliente dentro de Walcu.       Condiciones laborales:    Contrato a jornada completa e indefinido –queremos a alguien para siempre ❤–.  Presencial 100% los cuatro primeros meses (para que entiendas de verdad cómo funcionamos)  2 días de remoto después  Podrás elegir tu horario de entrada y salida –aunque siempre hay que cubrir

description: 뉴로퓨전 소개   뉴로퓨전은 Agentic AI 기반 금융정보 플랫폼  Valley AI, CereFin AI 를 만드는 팀입니다. 2022년 서비스 런칭 이후 유료 고객 10,000명 이상이 이용하는 플랫폼으로 성장했고, 2024년 Dow Jones News 해외진출 파트너 선정, 2025년 프리미어파트너스 Series A 50억 원 유치와 중소벤처기업부 장관상 수상을 거치며 빠르게 확장하고 있습니다. 현재 약 70명의 구성원이 함께하고 있으며, 2026년 청년일자리 강소기업으로 선정되었습니다.     조직이 커지면서 사람과 공간에 관한 일을 전담으로 맡아 줄 분이 필요해졌습니다. 채용부터 입·퇴사, 급여, 복리후생, 오피스 운영까지 구성원들이 일에만 집중할 수 있는 환경을 만들어 주실 경영지원팀 매니저를 찾습니다.      주요 업무    채용 운영: 채용공고 등록·채널 관리, 면접 일정 조율, 지원자 커뮤니케이션 등  입·퇴사 관리: 근로계약, 4대보험 취득·상실 신고, 온보딩·오프보딩 프로세스 운영  급여·보상: 매월 급여 산정 지원 및 급여대장 관리, 연말정산·성과급 지급 프로세스 운영  노무·규정: 근태관리 시스템 운영, 취업규칙·사내 인사규정 정비, 노동관계법 개정 대응  복리후생·HR 운영: 사내근로복지기금·복지제도 운영, HRIS 데이터 관리 및 인사 리포트 작성  오피스 운영: 사무공간·시설·비품 관리, 총무 예산 및 지출 증빙 관리  사내 행사·행정 지원: 워크샵 등 사내 이벤트 기획·운영, 출입 보안·안전 점검 대응, 회의체·문서 관리 지원       자격 요건    인사 또는 총무 분야 실무 경험 3년 이상 7년 이하 (두 영역을 겸한 경험이면 더욱 좋습니다)  4대보험 취득·상실 신고 및 급여 실무(산정 지원·연말정산 등) 경험  근로기준법 등 노동관계법에 대한 기본적인 이해  꼼꼼한 문서·데이터 관리 습관과 스프레드시트(Excel/Google Sheets) 활용 능력  구성원·지원자·외부 파트너와 원활하게 소통하는 커뮤니케이션 능력       우대 사항    스타트업·중소기업에서 인사와 총무를 1인 다역으로 담당해 본 경험  ATS(그리팅 등) 활용 채용 코디네이션 경험  HRIS·근태관리 시스템 도입 또는 운영 경험  사내근로복지기금 운영 경험  노무법인 협업 또는 노무 이슈 대응 경험  사내 행사·복지 프로그램을 직접 기획하고 운영해 본 경험       채용 프로세스    서류 심사  실무 인터뷰  최종 인터뷰      충원 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.      지원 시 참고   이력서에 간단한 자기소개와 지원 이유를 포함해 주세요.  인사·총무 업무 중 직접 담당했던 범위(채용·급여·노무·오피스 운영 등)를 구체적으로 적어 주시면 검토에 큰 도움이 됩니다.

We power the customer experience for Xe, Ria Money Transfer, and Dandelion, three distinct brands united by a shared commitment to making cross-border payments simple, transparent, and accessible for everyone. Our Values      COMMITMENT – is the first step in our journey toward a best-in-class foreign exchange and cross-border payments experience. RESPECT – is an act of humility, grounded in giving rather than receiving, fostering a respectful environment, which starts with leading by example. title: Renewals Manager
description: Role Overview  This role engages early and often with customers and partners, together with Renewals Specialists, often initiating and leading conversations to understand business needs, technology objectives, and long-term plans across multiple accounts and segments. It builds relationships with customers and channel partner teams to understand business priorities and objectives, ensuring alignment with the CX recurring revenue strategy. title: Client Solutions Manager, Apps & Gaming - GBS, TikTok Korea
description: Responsibilities  The Global Business Solutions (GBS) team helps brands grow on TikTok by connecting creativity, culture, media and commerce. As TikTok continues to grow at speed globally, GBS partners with advertisers to unlock business impact through our advertising solutions, client partnerships, product expertise and data-driven campaign strategies.  Within GBS Korea, the Apps & Gaming team works with some of the most dynamic advertisers across gaming, entertainment, emerging apps and digital services. The team helps clients acquire, engage and retain users by turning TikTok's platform, products and insights into measurable growth.  We are looking for a Client Solutions Manager to help Apps & Gaming advertisers grow their business on TikTok. This role is for someone who understands the app ecosystem, performance marketing and campaign optimisation deeply and who is excited by the opportunity to turn data, product expertise and client relationships into commercial impact. title: Lab Operations Manager
description:
About Substrate

Substrate is the critical infrastructure layer between AI and biology. AI for biology has a data problem, not a compute problem: biological foundation models can predict but cannot experiment, and the large-scale, high-quality data they need does not exist. We are building the lab that generates it, with quality and provenance built in. We are not a CRO and we are not a cloud lab.

The company was founded by Mostafa ElSayed, co-founder and CEO; Oli Hoy, who leads the lab buildout and operations; Alexey Morgunov, who leads science and intelligence software; and Anna Huyghues-Despointes, who leads partnerships and go-to-market.

The role

You will run the day-to-day operations of our lab in London, and be the person the scientists come to when something is missing, broken, late or lost. The day-one work is what you would expect: consumables and stock, goods in and cold chain, equipment servicing and calibration, suppliers and purchasing, waste streams and safety records.

Three parts go beyond a standard lab operations job. The first is provenance. Every experiment we sell carries a record of what went into it, down to the lot of the consumable used and the conditions material was held in. If a lot number is not captured, the data point is worth less, and that record runs through you.

The second is that the systems are not written yet. Inventory, goods in, asset registers and ordering exist in no form that will survive the next year. You define what the lab has to capture and work with the science and software teams to make sure it does.

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Ads Bidding
description:
Staff Machine Learning Engineer – Ads Bidding

The Team

The Ads ML team builds and maintains the machine learning models powering Deliveroo's advertising product — connecting consumers with relevant ads and helping merchants, grocers, and FMCG brands grow through the platform. The UK team is ~11 MLEs across ads and promotions, and collaborates closely with the US team (meetings capped at 4pm UK to protect reasonable hours).

The Problem

Deliveroo is migrating ads from cost-per-click (CPC) to cost-per-order (CPO) — merchants pay when an ad drives an order, not when it's clicked. This is a genuinely open, cutting-edge problem: very few companies have solved it, and there's no established playbook to follow. The exact approach is under active discussion and you'd be central to driving it.

You will:

  • Own the design and execution of the CPC-to-CPO migration, including the core open question of whether the system stays CPO-facing externally while optimising CPC behind the scenes, or some hybrid of the two

  • Build and improve the bidding surface: goal-based automated bidding, Target CPO, optimised CPC, and Target ROAS

  • Own yield management tied to ROS targeting

  • Partner daily with the DoorDash US team to align on approach across markets

  • Set technical direction for the domain

Requirements

  • Expertise in ad economics, marketplace bidding, or auction theory

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airb

title: Senior Legal Counsel – Contracts (German speaker)
description:
Could your legal expertise help build the contractual foundations of Europe’s next financial management platform?

 

At Pennylane, we believe legal should be more than a safeguard. It should be a business enabler.

Our ambition is to equip millions of small and medium-sized businesses across Europe with a complete, high-performing financial management platform. As Pennylane continues to grow rapidly in France and expand internationally, we are looking for a Senior Legal Counsel, Contracts to join our Legal, Compliance & Risk team.

Within a Legal department of 10 professionals, the Contracts team secures Pennylane’s commercial and operational relationships with customers, suppliers, partner firms, resellers, integrators and strategic partners.

Reporting to the Lead Legal Counsel, Contracts, you will work closely with our Sales, Partnerships, Security, Finance and Product teams. This is a hands-on role where legal rigor, creativity and business pragmatism are equally valued.

title: Senior Legal Counsel – Contracts (German speaker)
description:
Could your legal expertise help build the contractual foundations of Europe’s next financial management platform?

 

At Pennylane, we believe legal should be more than a safeguard. It should be a business enabler.

Our ambition is to equip millions of small and medium-sized businesses across Europe with a complete, high-performing financial management platform. As Pennylane continues to grow rapidly in France and expand internationally, we are looking for a Senior Legal Counsel, Contracts to join our Legal, Compliance & Risk team.

Within a Legal department of 10 professionals, the Contracts team secures Pennylane’s commercial and operational relationships with customers, suppliers, partner firms, resellers, integrators and strategic partners.

Reporting to the Lead Legal Counsel, Contracts, you will work closely with our Sales, Partnerships, Security, Finance and Product teams. This is a hands-on role where legal rigor, creativity and business pragmatism are equally valued.

 

🌍 What is Pennylane?

 

Pennylane is one of France’s most dynamic fintech companies, currently expanding rapidly across Europe.

💻 Establish ourselves in the market as an innovative provider of accounting and financial management software

title: Responsable Onboarding Comptable
description:

Nous recherchons des profils Formateur avec une solide expérience en comptabilité pour accompagner nos cabinets partenaires sur la prise en main de notre outil. La zone à couvrir est Nice.

  • Tu intègres ton équipe et tu passes du temps avec un mentor (consultant en formation accrédité) et le responsable de formation pour te familiariser avec ce nouvel environnement.

title: Financial Planning & Analysis GTM Lead
description:
About Dutchie

Founded in 2017, Dutchie is a comprehensive technology platform powering dispensary operations, while providing consumers with safe and easy access to cannabis. Dutchie aims to further support the positive societal change the cannabis industry brings to the world through wellness benefits, social justice, and empowering local communities through tax revenue. Powering thousands of dispensaries across 40+ markets throughout the United States and Canada, Dutchie is the leading technology company in the cannabis space and was named in Fast Company’s 10 Most Innovative Companies in North America and listed two years in a row on LinkedIn’s Top 50 Startups.

Dutchie is looking for a Financial Planning and Analysis GTM lead to serve as the primary finance partner to our Revenue organization.

  • Analyze performance across customer segments, products, territories, and revenue motions.
  • Evaluate sales efficiency, marketing investment, customer acquisition economics, and unit economics.
  • Develop scenario analyses that inform resource allocation and investment priorities.

Decision Support

  • Translate complex GTM data into executive-level insights and recommendations.
  • Partner closely with Revenue Operations to improve forecasting accuracy and reporting consistency.
  • Support quarterly business reviews, annual planning, and board-level reporting.

AI & Operational Scale

  • Leverage AI and automation to accelerate

About This Job

Dutchie is on a mission to make cannabis accessible — and we do that by building the technology that powers dispensaries end-to-end: point of sale, ecommerce, payments, loyalty, and marketing. Our Support team sits at the center of that mission. When something isn't working for a dispensary, we're the ones who make it right; fast, sharp, and calm.

The Product Support Specialist is our frontline expert across the full Dutchie platform. You'll own inbound contacts for our full stack of products, troubleshoot technically complex issues, navigate multiple systems, and be the person dispensary staff rely on when things get hard in the middle of a busy shift. Many of the analysts, engineers, implementation strategists, operations specialists, and more started in this exact position or very similar, meaning this can be a launchpad for future career growth.

One more thing worth being direct about: Dutchie is actively building AI into how cannabis retail operates. We utilize AI-powered support products, and we're rolling out agentic modules across the platform that change how dispensaries interact with their technology. AI isn't a tool we use on the side, it's woven into the product you'll be supporting and the workflow you'll operate in every day. We're looking for someone genuinely curious about these tools, invested in learning them, and willing to push on them when they fall short. If you've been waiting for a support role where the technology is actually interesting, this is it.

What You’ll Do

Customer interaction and resolution

  • Handle inbound contacts via email, phone, and live chat across POS, ecommerce, payments, loyalty, hardware, and integrations
  • Troubleshoot complex platform issues: back office configuration, register transactions, receipt reconciliation, menu sync failures, discount and pricing issues

description:

BetterHelp is on a mission to champion the well-being in all of us. We’re working to make mental healthcare more accessible, so more people can get the support they need, when they need it. As the world’s largest online therapy service, we’ve connected millions of people with a network of more than 30,000 licensed therapists-- and we’re not stopping there. As the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.

As Director, Corporate Counsel at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. This role requires someone who can think strategically about how to operationalize partnerships, translating legal agreements into effective business processes, and who thrives in a cross-functional environment working with sales, product, marketing, and engineering.   • Collaborate with marketing, partnerships, product, and business development teams.
  • Negotiate marketing, sponsorship, and affiliate agreements, including campaigns with influencers, content creators, and third-party wellness platforms, ensuring compliance with healthcare and advertising regulations.
  • Partner with sales and operations to design and operationalize new partnership frameworks, ensuring that legal, business, and technical requirements are fully aligned.

You'll have real ownership at a company where marketing has a seat at the strategy table. The category is converging, the timing is right, and the person in this seat will shape how an entire market talks about insider risk in the AI era.

The base salary range for this position is commensurate with work location, experience, skills, certifications, education, and prior accomplishments. The position may be eligible for additional compensation, including a bonus and/or commission as applicable.

title: Marketing Designer, Web
description:
Overview of the role:

PolicyMe is building a simpler, more affordable insurance experience for Canadian families. Our website is where customers learn, build trust, and take the next step toward coverage. We’re hiring a Marketing Designer, Web to raise the visual quality of that experience. You’ll design, improve, and maintain our marketing site built using Webflow; turn Growth briefs into polished, component-led pages; and own quality through launch. Most of your work will be web and CMS-based, with select opportunities to support campaign creative, slides, ads, email UI, and other brand assets.

This is not a product-design, UX-research, or front-end developer role. We need a strong visual designer with exceptional judgment in typography, hierarchy, layout, responsive design, and the details that make a page feel considered. You don’t need to be a Webflow expert on day one: CMS fluency, good technical judgment, and an appetite to learn matter more.

What you'll be doing:

Design and ship great marketing web experiences

  • Turn Growth and Content briefs into polished Figma designs for landing pages, product pages, editorial hubs, and campaigns.
  • Build clear, conversion-aware, accessible, and responsive layouts using our design system and existing components.
  • Design new components when needed, extending our design system in a cohesive, reusable way.
  • Improve the marketing site’s everyday surfaces, including navigation, templates, content modules, and EN/FR experiences (French language is not required) with the same care as major launches.
  • Bring a point of view to how PolicyMe shows up visually. As a startup, you’ll have meaningful input into the evolution of our web and marketing design identity, in partnership with Growth and Design leadership.

Own CMS quality and publishing

  • Learn and use our CMS and Webflow environment to build, update, and publish pages.
  • Own pre- and post-launch quality: responsive checks, visual QA, content and link validation, localization review, and clear resolution of inconsistencies.
  • Maintain and improve reusable Figma and CMS components, templates, and guardrails so the team can ship faster without compromising quality.

Lead implementation with development agencies

  • Create complete handoffs for Webflow/development partners, covering interaction states, edge cases, annotations, and walkthroughs.
  • Manage design feedback through implementation and ensure launched work matches the intended experience.
  • Coordinate with Growth, Content, Design, and Engineering to clarify scope, surface dependencies, and keep projects moving.

Be involved in Growth’s broader creative work

  • Support selected needs across campaign creative, ads, slide templates, email UI

description:
Job Overview

We are looking for an Opto-mechanical Engineer to join our Manufacturing team and play a critical role in the design, integration, and manufacturing of opto-mechanical systems for our photonic products. This role will sit at the intersection of mechanical design, optics, and manufacturing, helping us translate optical designs into robust, manufacturable hardware.

You will take ownership of designing and validating opto-mechanical assemblies, including mounts, and alignment structures for optical and photonic components. You will work closely with Hardware, and manufacturing engineering teams as well as vendors from across the world to ensure designs are optically sound, mechanically robust, and ready for scalable production.

This is a highly hands-on engineering role suited to someone comfortable moving between CAD design, optical modelling, and physical prototyping and testing. You will be expected to troubleshoot mechanical and optical integration issues, iterate on designs quickly, and help establish repeatable, production-ready opto-mechanical solutions. Fresh graduates with strong relevant project, internship, or academic experience are welcome to apply.

What you'll be doing

  • Design opto-mechanical components and assemblies (mounts, housings, brackets, alignment stages) using SolidWorks

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Python) - Remote
description:
Breathment is a Munich-based digital health startup. We digitize pulmonary rehabilitation for people living with chronic respiratory diseases such as COPD: our app guides patients through therapy exercises at home, watches their movement through the phone camera and gives feedback in real time, while physiotherapists and physicians follow their progress remotely through our telemonitoring platform. We work with German clinics, physiotherapists and health insurers, and every release reaches real patients.

We are looking for a senior engineer who is at home in both worlds: computer vision and production backend. You will own the path from neural-network output to what the patient sees on screen and what the therapist reads in the report.

Tasks

  • Own the computer-vision pipeline that turns pose-estimation output from our neural networks into repetition counts, posture feedback and set-by-set exercise analysis.
  • Design the reporting layer that converts raw movement data into clinical reports physiotherapists act on.
  • Build and extend our Python backend (FastAPI, MongoDB, Redis): the API behind the patient app and the clinician platform.
  • Ship to production on Kubernetes with GPU inference services, and stand behind what you ship: tests, monitoring and clean handovers.
  • Analyse requirements together with product, physiotherapists and the mobile team, and propose solutions instead of waiting for tickets.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software development in Python, including production REST APIs (FastAPI or comparable).

Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we’re adding an Account Executive to the German-speaking team.

Unlike traditional transactional sales, you'll be selling complex supply chain software to technical buyers—requiring deep discovery, consultative selling, and the ability to prove measurable ROI in a trillion-dollar industry. The impact is tangible, the industry is fascinating, and the growth trajectory is yours to shape.

title: Visiting Founders Associate (Engineering)

About Peec AI

Peec AI is the analytics platform for AI search. People increasingly discover products and make buying decisions through ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews instead of traditional search, and most brands have no idea where they show up in those answers. Peec gives marketing, SEO, and growth teams the data to see exactly that: how visible their brand is across AI platforms, how they compare to competitors, and where to win.

 

We are defining this category, and the market is moving with us. Peec is a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, past $10M ARR, with a 80+ person team across our Berlin HQ and our new New York office.

About the role

We're looking for a Visiting Founders Associate to join our engineering team in Berlin. You'll be the operational backbone of the team, running the processes, projects, and internal work that keep everything moving, so our engineers can stay focused on building.

The main piece of the role is our compliance work, which you'll coordinate and execute end to end. title: Technical Lead, Laser Amplification (f/m/d)
description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to provide clean, safe, and virtually unlimited energy to the world. We are rapidly scaling and looking for talented individuals who thrive in building clarity and structure within fast-growing environments.

Your Role

As Technical Lead, Laser Amplification, you will own the end-to-end technical delivery of the laser amplification subsystem. The amplification chain is the primary energy-scaling element of the laser system, so this role is central to translating ICF system requirements into an integrated, high-performing function.

You will define the subsystem architecture, establish the technical roadmap, lead design and test activities, manage interfaces and risks, and develop the team and capabilities needed to take the amplification chain from concept through hardware delivery and integration.


What you’ll do

  • Define and own the technical architecture for Main Amplifier systems from concept through design freeze, including topology, gain media, pump geometry, thermal management, ASE control, and interface specifications.

  • Ensure that the amplification architecture and development activities remain traceable to ICF system-level laser requirements.

  • Build and maintain the technical roadmap for Light Amplification, aligning development sequence, capability gaps, technology maturity, and program milestones.

  • Lead the design, build, characterization, and integration of the amplification chain.

title: Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows.
You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

What you will work on

  • Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics  and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
  • Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on.
  • Cloud infrastructure on GCP. Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you.
  • Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now  and bringing the rest of the team along with it.

What we are building

At ecoplanet, we're redefining energy for tomorrow. Our mission: turn energy management into the competitive edge every European business relies on to win its market. We're building the operating system for the energy transition — cutting energy costs, improving efficiency, and streamlining operations. Backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and more, and built by a team full of top-tier talent.


Why This Role Matters

You will build and run the data backbone the whole product sits on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to get that data in clean, on time, and in a shape that dashboards, insights and forecasts can rely on.

You will join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.


What You’ll Achieve

  • Meter data integration. Connect industrial hardware and utility data streams into real-time dashboards. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is bringing data into a consistent structure across all sites
  • Anomalies and insights. This is where data science comes in. Find the things in the data a customer would want to know about — a meter drifting, a machine left running overnight, consumption that does not fit the pattern — and turn them into something they can act on
  • Tech stack and growth. Support the engineering team building scalable data pipeline


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • At least 3–5 years in a data engineering role or something close to it, building pipelines other people depend on

  • Hands-on data science experience. You do not need a research background. You do need to have built and evaluated models yourself: enough to tell a real anomaly from noise, to judge when a fi

title: Internship - Workplace and People Operations
description:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.
