title: Post-doctorat en interprétabilité mécaniste et diversité des représentations
description:
Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation.

Le poste est basé à Brest, au sein de l'équipe BRAIN (BRoader Artificial INtelligence) du Lab-STICC (UMR CNRS 6285). L'équipe travaille sur les fondements de l'apprentissage automatique (représentations, apprentissage frugal, modèles de fondation, traitement du signal) et sur leurs applications, en particulier en santé. Elle a récemment développé REVE, un modèle de fondation pour l'électroencéphalographie pré-entraîné sur plus de 25 000 sujets (NeurIPS 2025), et s’intéresse aux modèles de langage à diffusion discrète et sur l'interprétabilité mécaniste.

Le projet ENDIVE étudie ce que la diversité peut apporter à l'apprentissage automatique lorsque le budget porte sur le nombre d'exemples annotés plutôt que sur la puissance de calcul. Dans ce régime, ce qu'apporte un nouvel exemple ne dépend plus seulement de sa qualité propre, mais de ce qui le distingue de ceux déjà vus. Le point d'entrée technique du projet est l'échantillonnage à garanties de diversité, et en particulier les processus ponctuels déterminantaux (DPP), dont la matrice de noyau encode à la fois la pertinence des points et leur similarité.

Als Teamhead Customer Service Center führst du Mitarbeitende personell, fachlich und organisatorisch, stellst gemeinsam mit dem Schichtbetrieb die Einhaltung der Service Levels und Qualitätsstandards sicher und entwickelst Services, Prozesse und Arbeitsabläufe kontinuierlich weiter. Du übernimmst Verantwortung im Tagesgeschäft, im Qualitäts- und Effizienzmanagement sowie in der Zusammenarbeit mit internen Schnittstellen und trägst damit wesentlich zur Stabilität und Weiterentwicklung des Customer Service Centers bei.     Das sind deine Aufgaben    Du führst Customer Service Agents und Schichtleiter personell, fachlich, organisatorisch und administrativ und förderst ihre Entwicklung durch Coaching, Monitoring, Zielvereinbarungen und regelmässige Standortbestimmungen.   Du stellst gemeinsam mit dem Schichtbetrieb die Einhaltung der Qualitätsgrundsätze, Service Levels und operativen Abläufe im 7/24h Customer Service Center sicher.   Du analysierst Qualitäts-, Effizienz- und Leistungskennzahlen, leitest geeignete Massnahmen ab und unterstützt ein wirkungsvolles Betriebscontrolling sowie Risk Management.   Du verantwortest Themen rund um Rekrutierung, Einarbeitung, Einsatz-, Schicht- und Ferienplanung in enger Zusammenarbeit mit HR, Schichtleitung und internen Schnittstellen.   Du entwickelst Services und Prozesse konzeptionell weiter, wirkst in Projekten mit und pflegst ein aktives Beziehungsmanagement zu relevanten Anspruchsgruppen.     Das bringst du mit    Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Fachschule oder eine gleichwertige Ausbildung sowie langjährige Berufserfahrung, idealerweise im Banken-, Karten- oder Zahlungsverkehrsumfeld.   Du bringst solide Führungserfahrung sowie Praxiserfahrung in einem Call Center, Customer Interaction Center oder Kundendienst mit. Erfahrung im 7/24h-Schichtbetrieb und im Workforce Management ist von Vorteil.   Du denkst prozessorientiert, handelst verantwortungsbewusst und verfügst über analytisches sowie konzeptionelles Denkvermögen, Veränderungsbereitschaft und Durchsetzungsvermögen.   Du überzeugst durch hohe Sozialkompetenz, ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Belastbarkeit, Teamfähigkeit, Flexibilität und eine klare Hands-on-Mentalität.   Du bist sicher im Umgang mit moderner Technik, Telefonie-, Multichannel- und Ticketing-Applikationen, verfügst über sehr gute MS Office-Kenntnisse und kommunizierst verhandlungssicher in Deutsch, Französisch, Englisch und Italienisch.

title: Avdelingsleder - Regionalt reponssenter
description: Vi søker avdelingsleder til 100 % fast stilling ved regionalt responssenter i enhet Legetjenester.  Kommunene står overfor store omstillingsbehov, og teknologi vil få en stadig viktigere rolle i utviklingen av bærekraftige helse- og omsorgstjenester. Vi ser etter en tydelig og utviklingsorientert leder som kan sikre god drift i dag - og samtidig være med på å forme morgendagens tjenester.  Regionalt responssenter (RRO)  RRO er en døgnkontinuerlig tjeneste og et regionalt kompetansemiljø for velferdsteknologi og digitale tjenester. Vi leverer tjenester til 12 medlemskommuner på Nordmøre, i Romsdal og Trøndelag og håndterer om lag 2 500 velferdsteknologiske alarmer. I tillegg leverer vi andre digitale tjenester til kommunale og private virksomheter, blant annet mottak av brannalarmer, tekniske varsler og overvåkings- og feilmeldingstjenester.  RRO er organisert som en egen avdeling i enhet Legetjenester - og er samlokalisert med legevakt og ambulansetjeneste på Løkkemyra i Kristiansund. Avdelingen består av operatører, teknikere og prosjekt-/utviklingsressurser. Operatørene er helsepersonell, og responssenteret er bemannet hele døgnet, hele året.   Om lederoppdraget   Gjennom delegert myndighet fra enhetsleder har du ansvar for avdelingens tjenestetilbud, økonomi og personalressurser. Du skal sikre stabil og forsvarlig døgnkontinuerlig drift, samtidig som du leder en tjeneste i kontinuerlig teknologisk og organisatorisk utvikling.  En viktig del av lederoppdraget er å utvikle RRO sammen med medarbeiderne og samarbeidskommunene. Du vil derfor arbeide både operativt og strategisk og ha kontakt med ledere, fagmiljøer, teknologileverandører og andre samarbeidspartnere.  Du blir en del av ledergruppen i enhet Legetjenester og rapporterer til enhetsleder.   Arbeidsområder     delegert lederansvar for fag, personal og økonomi - og du leder i tråd med kommunens oppdrag og enhetens mål  sørge for at medarbeiderne dine opplever et støttende lederskap, faglig utvikling og mestring i møtet med oppgavene  ansvar for planlagt kompetanse og bemanning, planlegge og utarbeide arbeidstidsordninger og ferieplaner  bistå enhetsleder med å utøve kommunens systematiske HMS-arbeid  følge opp samarbeidskommunene i tråd med vertskommuneavtalen og bidra til godt eierskap og samarbeid  delta i og bidra til anskaffelses-, implementerings- og utviklingsprosesser innen fagområdet  samarbeide tett med kommunens øvrige helse- og omsorgstjenester, IT-miljø og eksterne samarbeidspartnere     Kvalifikasjonskrav     relevant høyere utdanning på minimum bachelornivå  ledererfaring  erfaring med endrings- og utviklingsarbeid  gode formidlingsevner i norsk, skriftlig og muntlig  solid digital kompetanse og forståelse     Det er en fordel om du også har     relevant videreutdnning, for eksempel innen ledelse, velferdsteknologi, digitalisering eller lignende  erfaring fra e-helse, velferdsteknologi, helse- og omsorgstjenester eller andre teknologitunge tjenesteområder  erfarin

title: Key Account Desk advisor til vores største kunder

description: Beskrivelse - ekstern   Vil du gerne arbejde for en af Danmarks bedste arbejdspladser, hvis vigtigste KPI er at have motiverede medarbejdere? Brænder du for at levere fantastiske kundeoplevelser og vil du gerne blive en del af et fantastisk kundefokuseret team? Så har vi jobbet til dig! Vi søger nemlig medarbejdere til vores Key Account Desk i kundeservice.    DHL Express har været inde i en rivende udvikling i de seneste år med stigende omsætning, støt voksende markedsandel og et stærkt brand. Hos os i DHL Express er det vigtigt, at alle er glade for at gå på arbejde. Vi tror på, at glade og engagerede medarbejdere giver den bedste service og kundeoplevelse. Vi er Danmarks største spiller inden for international ekspres, og blandt både Danmarks og Verdens Bedste Arbejdspladser (#3 i DK, #1 i Europa og #1 i Verden) på grund af vores kultur og det sociale fokus vi har i DHL Express. Det er kåringer, vi er meget stolte af, og som kun er mulig at få med topmotiverede, engagerede og dygtige medarbejdere til at styre os i den rigtige retning.   Stillingen    Med reference til Key Account Desk Supervisor kommer du til at fungere som kontaktperson for et antal af DHL's største kunder. På telefon og via mail skal du fungere som problemløser for vores kunder. Et af de vigtigste keypoints er at koordinere de forskellige opgaver, så de bliver løst effektivt med en høj kvalitet. Du vil blive målt på din indsats personligt og som del af et team. Stillingen er IKKE i vores salgsafdeling, men i vores kundeservice.   Arbejdsopgaver       Tilsikre at kundens problemer løses samt overholde deadlines og aftaler   Skabe en god kunderelation   Kontakt med kunder pr. e-mail og telefon   Daglig rapportering til kunderne       Din profil    Som Key Account Desk Advisor er det vigtigt, at du i stor udstrækning har følgende egenskaber:     Proaktiv adfærd   Udadvendt, både over for kunderne og internt i organisationen   Innovativ i forhold til den service vi yder til vores kunder   Beslutningsdygtig og handlekraftig   Overblik og prioriteringsevne   Behersker dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale   God situationsfornemmelse   Ambitiøs, målrettet og fleksibel.   Branchekendskab en fordel og så skal du kunne fremvise en ren straffeattest ved en evt. ansættelse.      Ansættelsen er fuldtid, 37 timer pr. uge ekskl. frokost. Arbejdstiden vil være mandag til fredag i tidsrummet kl. 08.00 – 17.00.    Vi tilbyder      En stilling i et internationalt miljø, hvor du skal medvirke til DHL’s fortsatte succes. title: Associate Product Owner
description:
TL;DR

Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM.

Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature.
Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself.

The problem you'll be solvingA corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder.
GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.


What we´re looking for

You have personally written the tickets.
3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off.
You are technical enough to argue with engineers.
AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better.
You can write.
A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second.

title: Manager, Applied AI Engineering (Codex)

The Applied AI Engineering team is responsible for helping customers turn frontier AI capabilities into real products, workflows, and business impact. description:
Our mission

Bounti is building the AI-native infrastructure layer for frontline teams, spanning training, audits, and autonomous operations. We partner with multi-location operators in frontline industries such as hospitality.
Behind the product sits a backend that has grown quickly: a Node and Postgres API, background workers, queues, and the AI pipelines powering our product. We're hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to own that layer as we scale it.


What you'll do

  • Own the backend behind the product: API design, data modelling, query performance, and the decisions that get harder to reverse the longer we leave them.

  • Own the AI pipelines: the ones running today and the next set of features we build on top of them, including versioned prompts, evaluation, cost and latency budgets, and graceful behaviour when a model provider has a bad day.

  • Connect Bounti to the systems customers already run: POS, scheduling, payroll, and whatever comes next. Build a shared layer rather than one-off connectors, so each new partner costs less than the last.
  • Make failure visible and recoverable: idempotency, reconciliation, per-customer alerting, and drift detection when a partner API misreports state.
  • Own the partner relationship on the technical side: sandbox access, certification programmes, API reviews.
  • Build internal tooling that empowers the CS team to diagnose failed syncs and enable integrations.

What's it all about?

The balance of power in the energy industry needs to change. The intermittency of renewable supply and the constant demands of the grid mean that we still rely on less efficient, more expensive and unsustainable fossil fuels to keep the lights on. At Gridfuse, our mission is to shift this balance through technology. To shift the balance of inputs, so that renewables become the world's main source of electricity.  

At Gridfuse, we develop the software that controls real renewable energy assets and turns them into a coordinated Virtual Power Plant (VPP) that can respond intelligently to energy markets and grid conditions.


Your impact

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the systems that connects our platform to these assets and turn energy-market and grid requirements into real-world actions. Your code will influence when batteries charge or discharge, how renewable assets respond, and how reliably these assets can participate in the electricity system. 

You will own and evolve core parts of the Control services, working closely with other software engineers and our renewable-energy experts.

  • Design and build distributed control systems that coordinate fleets of batteries, wind turbines and solar plants

  • Build the services responsible for communicating with physical assets and processing their telemetry, status and capabilities 
  • Design systems that continue to behave predictably when devices fail, networks are unreliable, messages arrive late or assets become temporarily unavailable
  • Build highly observable and resilient services that operate continuously in production

title: Working Student (all genders) – Robust Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction for Dynamic Scene
description:
Abstract

Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models can recover scene geometry directly from images or videos without costly scene-specific optimization. By combining large-scale pre-training, multi-view reasoning, and strong geometric priors, these models provide an efficient alternative to traditional reconstruction pipelines such as Structure-from-Motion, NeRF, and optimization-based 3D Gaussian Splatting.

Despite recent progress, current models remain sensitive to challenging real-world conditions. Occlusions, moving objects, illumination changes, nighttime scenes, reflections, rain, fog, and snow can result in incomplete geometry, unreliable correspondences, and temporally inconsistent predictions. Improving robustness under such conditions is essential for autonomous driving and robotic perception.

As a working student, you will support the development of robust feed-forward reconstruction models for dynamic scenes. You will investigate methods for handling occlusion, changing illumination, and adverse weather, and explore how large reconstruction models can serve as general-purpose geometric backbones for downstream 3D scene understanding, particularly semantic occupancy prediction and 4D occupancy forecasting.


These tasks interest you

  • Develop and evaluate feed-forward 3D reconstruction models for dynamic scenes using monocular or multi-view image sequences.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
Who is Boulevard?

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come to the best work of your life at Boulevard.

Own the automation engine that powers Boulevard’s next phase of growth.

Boulevard is building a high-efficiency, AI-leveraged go-to-market engine as we scale from $50M toward $250M in revenue. As our SDR and AE teams grow, we are committed to scaling productivity through automation, not headcount alone.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on systems builder with deep CRM expertise and a pragmatic approach to AI and automation that drives measurable business outcomes.

You will report to the Director of Revenue Operations and partner closely with Sales Ops, Marketing Ops, Revenue Enablement, and Analytics to design and operationalize scalable workflows that dramatically reduce manual lift, increase demos per rep, and improve pipeline performance.

What you'll do here:

  • Own the architecture and evolution of automation workflows across Salesforce, Clay, LeanData, Gong, and Outreach to support outbound prospecting, enrichment, lead routing, and lifecycle management.
  • Design and operationalize AI-driven enrichment workflows in Clay, including custom prompt logic to extract relevant data from SMB web

title: Staff DevOps Engineer (Platform)
description:
Phantom is on a mission to connect the world to the freedom of open markets. Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide.

Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Phantom partners with many of the most trusted and influential names in finance like Hyperliquid, Stripe, Kalshi and Visa, to make the most popular and innovative financial products accessible to everyone.

We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm.

This role is fully remote; however, we’re only open to candidates based in the US, EU and UK.

Responsibilities

  • SDLC Infrastructure Ownership: Own and evolve CI/CD infrastructure using GitHub Actions and Kubernetes, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and developer velocity.

  • Mobile Release Automation: Automate release workflows including building, signing, and distributing binaries and managing app store submissions across iOS, Android, and Chrome.

  • e2e Test Automation: Oversee and improve automated end-to-end testing with Maestro and Playwright across mobile and web.

  • CI/CD Optimization: Improve pipeline performance, reliability, and observability to support rapid, high-confidence releases.

  • Developer Experience: Partner with engineering teams on SDLC and DevEx improvements, including preview environments and tooling such as Appetize.

  • Security & Compliance: Help ensure build, release, and deployment systems meet the security and compliance expectations of a financial product.

  • Technical Leadership: Set standards and drive improvements across build, test, release, and deployment workflows, partnering closely with product and engineering teams.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, SRE, Systems Engineering, or a related role, with experience operating at a senior or staff level.

  • Strong experience with AWS and CI/CD systems such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI.

  • Strong experience with Docker, Kuber

title: Director of Customer Success Operations
description:
About Securly

Securly is the K-12 market leader in AI-powered student safety and wellness solutions, protecting more than 20 million students across 20,000+ schools. Our mission is to create safer, more supportive learning environments by detecting potential harm, supporting student mental health, and empowering educators with actionable insights that help students thrive.

By turning data into meaningful, actionable intelligence, Securly enables schools to identify risk earlier, reduce harmful incidents, and strengthen student support — driving measurable improvements in safety and wellbeing. We're proud to be recognized as a Top Place to Work, named to TIME's America's Top EdTech Companies 2026 list, a Top 40 Most Used EdTech, and one of the 150 most transformational growth companies.

The Role

Securly is looking for a Director, Customer Success Operations to lead the systems, processes, and people behind our entire post-sale customer journey. You'll lead our CS Ops and Renewals function - a CS Ops Manager, a CS Ops Specialist, and a team of Renewals Specialists - and own Vitally, our Customer Success platform, as the operational backbone of the business.

This is a builder's role. Vitally has been live for about a year, and the next chapter is yours to write: deepening adoption, sharpening health scoring, automating renewals workflows, and turning good instincts into a repeatable, data-driven system that scales. You'll be the operational thought partner to CS executives - using data and process design to make sure customer growth and success directly fuel Securly's growth.
Location: Remote (U.S.) Type: Full-Time, Exempt Reports to: SVP, Customer Success

What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days, you'll get under the hood - auditing our Vitally configuration, current CS Ops and renewals workflows, and team structure. You'll build real relationships with your team and ship your first wave of improvements: sharper health scoring, better dashboards, and a more programmatic renewals process.

By 6 months, you're driving measurable gains - better renewals efficiency, stronger forecast accuracy, and dashboards that CS and company leadership actually rely on to run the business.

By your first year, you own a mature CS Ops and Renewals function that consistently meets or exceeds retention targets, backed by a trained, accountable team and a Vitally instance that scales with Securly's growth.

What You'll Do

Lead the team

  • Hire, coach, and manage a team of a CS Ops Manager, a CS Ops Specialist, and Renewals Specialists - setting clear goals and holding the team accountable to them
  • Structure team capacity

title: Lead Customer Experience & Support (m/w/d) 100% Remote
description: Die Alparis GmbH mit Sitz in Bottighofen am Bodensee betreibt Revitera, eine junge Marke für Nahrungsergänzung im Direktvertrieb an Endkundinnen und Endkunden. Unser Shop läuft auf Shopify. Der Schwerpunkt unserer Kundschaft liegt heute im deutschsprachigen Raum, längst aber nicht mehr ausschliesslich: Wir skalieren gerade in weitere europäische Märkte und bereiten den Schritt nach Amerika vor.   Wir sind ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen und ohne Konzernstrukturen. Was hier entschieden wird, ist am selben Tag live. Gerade bauen wir unseren Kundenservice technisch neu auf: eine eigene Software, die einen wachsenden Teil der Kommunikation automatisiert und die wir zusammen mit unserer IT laufend weiterentwickeln.   Für diesen Bereich suchen wir die Person, die bei uns die Kundenzufriedenheit verantwortet. Diese Rolle ist die Schnittstelle zwischen allen Teams und unseren Kundinnen und Kunden. Wer sie ausfüllt, kennt unsere Kundschaft besser als alle anderen im Haus, kennt die Produkte, die Strategie und die Ziele dahinter, und trägt dieses Wissen in jedes andere Team zurück. Entsprechend gross ist der Einfluss auf das, was wir bauen.  Aufgaben  • Du übernimmst die vollständige Verantwortung für die Kundenzufriedenheit bei Revitera und für alles, was daran hängt.   • Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kundinnen und Kunden und allen internen Teams. Was du aus dem Kontakt lernst, spielst du strukturiert an Produkt, Shop, IT und Marketing zurück.   • Du lernst unsere Kundschaft wirklich kennen, sammelst Feedback systematisch ein und machst daraus verwertbare Erkenntnisse statt Bauchgefühl.   • Du baust den Kundensupport von Grund auf: Prozesse, Antwortstandards, Tonalität, Eskalationswege und die Struktur dahinter.   • Du entwickelst effiziente Systeme, mit denen die Kommunikation mit unserer Kundschaft besser, schneller und persönlicher wird.   • Du treibst die Automatisierung dieses Bereichs voran: Du arbeitest eng mit unserer IT an unserer eigenen Support-Software, testest sie, bringst deine Praxiserfahrung in die Weiterentwicklung des Algorithmus ein und entscheidest mit, was automatisiert wird und was in menschliche Hand gehört.   • Du verantwortest das Bewertungsmanagement, also Shop-Bewertungen, Bewertungsportale und öffentliche Rückmeldungen.   • Du führst die Kundensupport-Mitarbeitenden: Einarbeitung, Qualitätssicherung, Weiterentwicklung.   • Mittelfristig übernimmst du zusätzlich das E-Mail-Marketing und die gesamte Kundenkommunikation ausserhalb der bezahlten Werbung. Die Stelle ist bewusst als wachsende Bereichsleitung angelegt.   Woran wir den Erfolg dieser Rolle messen:   • Customer Retention, also wie viele Kundinnen und Kunden bei uns bleiben. Das ist die wichtigste Zahl.   • Kundenzufriedenheit über alle Kontaktpunkte hinweg.   • Möglichst viele positive und möglichst wenige negative Bewertungen, sowie ein aktives Bewertungsmanagement.   • Der Automatisierungsgrad im Kundenservice, also wie viel wir ohne Qualitätsverlust

At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers. We aim to decarbonise building materials, making up 11% of global GHG emissions. With this, we are building the digital infrastructure to make it faster, easier, and more sustainable to build the world around us.

title: Head of Accounting Europe (m/w/d)
description:
Sie möchten Verantwortung für internationale Accounting-Prozesse übernehmen und gleichzeitig ein Finance-Team fachlich weiterentwickeln? Für ein international tätiges Unternehmen im produzierenden Industrieumfeld suchen wir einen Head of Accounting Europe (m/w/d) in Düsseldorf, der operative Accounting-Expertise mit Führungskompetenz und einem ausgeprägten Verständnis für Financial Reporting verbindet.

Unser Kunde ist ein international aufgestelltes, wachsendes Industrieunternehmen mit einem technisch anspruchsvollen Produktportfolio und globalen Strukturen. Das Unternehmen verbindet langjährige Markterfahrung mit kontinuierlicher Weiterentwicklung und bietet Ihnen ein dynamisches Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und internationaler Zusammenarbeit.

Aufgaben

  • Sie verantworten die Accounting-Prozesse mehrerer Gesellschaften und stellen eine vollständige sowie korrekte Finanzberichterstattung sicher.
  • Sie steuern den gesamten Monatsabschluss inklusive Hauptbuch, Bilanzabstimmungen, Buchungen und Konsolidierung.
  • Sie erstellen und analysieren Gewinn- und Verlustrechnungen, Bilanzen sowie Cashflow-Auswertungen.
  • Sie führen ein Accounting-Team und fördern die fachliche sowie persönliche Weiterentwicklung Ihrer Mitarbeiter.
  • Sie entwickeln bestehende Accounting-Prozesse, Systeme und Strukturen kontinuierlich weiter und erhöhen deren Effizienz.
  • Sie stellen die Einhaltung relevanter Rechnungslegungsstandards und interner Accounting-Richtlinien sicher.
  • Sie konzipieren und optimieren interne Kontrollsysteme im Bereich Financial Reporting und Accounting.
  • Sie analysieren Abweichungen, finanzielle Entwicklungen und Kennzahlen und leiten daraus Handlungsempfehlungen ab.
  • Sie unterstützen die Erstellung von Budgets und Forecasts und arbeiten dabei eng mit dem Management sowie den Fachbereichen zusammen.
  • Sie überwachen Cashflow- und Budgetabweichungen und schaffen Transpare

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Customer Success Manager    Fulltime (32-40 uur) · Amsterdam · Pluvo      Bij Pluvo meten we succes niet aan hoeveel klanten we binnenhalen, maar aan hoe lang ze blijven. Vanuit ons supportteam helpen we klanten al snel en persoonlijk zodra ze een vraag hebben, en dat gaat goed. Nu willen we een stap verder: van reactief goed geholpen worden naar proactief en strategisch meedenken met onze klanten. Daarom zoeken we een ervaren customer success collega die die strategische kant opzet, de regie pakt en zorgt dat klanten voor de lange termijn aan ons verbonden blijven.      Over Pluvo   Pluvo.com is een leerplatform waarmee organisaties hun opleidingen, e-learnings en compliance centraal organiseren in een eigen academie. Onze klanten werken onder andere bij overheden, productiebedrijven en in de logistiek. We helpen hen om leren overzichtelijk, toegankelijk en ook leuk te maken.     We zijn een snelgroeiend, innovatief softwarebedrijf, maar persoonlijk contact staat bij ons voorop. We werken volop met AI en slimme oplossingen, niet om het menselijke eruit te halen, maar juist om meer tijd en ruimte te maken voor echt contact met onze klanten. We geloven dat we samen met hen de toekomst van leren bouwen. Dat vertaalt zich in de beste service in de markt: snel, deskundig en altijd met een echt mens aan de lijn. En precies daar draait deze rol om.      Jouw rol   Als Customer Success Manager bouw je de strategische, proactieve kant van customer success op, bovenop de sterke reactieve basis die we vanuit support al hebben. Tegelijk ben je een belangrijk gezicht van Pluvo voor onze klanten: je bepaalt hoe we ze begeleiden, betrokken houden en laten groeien, en je voert het zelf uit met de belangrijkste accounts.     Je zet onze customer success-aanpak op. Je bedenkt en richt het kwartaalproces in, zet klantevents, focusgroepen en klanttevredenheidsonderzoek op en verbetert dat continu op basis van wat werkt. Twee dingen bouw je hierin van de grond af op: een heldere roadmap per key account, zodat je gericht met elke klant werkt aan hun doelen, en een data-driven manier van werken, waarbij je bepaalt welke signalen en cijfers we volgen om klantgeluk en -behoud te sturen. Je krijgt hierin veel eigenaarschap: jij bepaalt grotendeels hoe we dit doen, en we verwachten dan ook dat je proactief initiatief neemt. Zie je iets wat beter kan? Dan pak je het op.     Je beheert een portfolio met onze belangrijkste key accounts. Je bent hun eerste aanspreekpunt, voert kwartaalmeetings op strategisch niveau en werkt met elke klant aan een roadmap richting hun doelen. Jij weet wat er speelt bij je klanten en zorgt dat Pluvo daar naadloos op aansluit.     Daarnaast help je incidenteel mee bij new business, bijvoorbeeld met een sales demo of door je productkennis in te zetten in een lopend traject.     En je draait mee in de supportchat (ongeveer 8 uur per week). Zo leer je Pluvo door en door kennen, blijf je op de hoogte van de laatste updates en houd je gevoel met

Our platform brings architecture, planning and execution into one place, with AI in the core, so teams can see clearly, decide together and move. We are a pod of around eighty people (we call ourselves Dolphins), sharing 30+ nationalities and proud of our cultural diversity and the many ways we think about the world.     We are looking for a  Customer Growth Manager  to join us at our Utrecht HQ.      The job in one paragraph   You own a portfolio of Dutch customers across a variety of sectors and you grow it. You start with around 30 accounts and build to roughly 100 over your first year, together worth about EUR 3 million in ARR. Two things sit at the centre: keeping customers, and expanding them. You work out what a customer is aiming to achieve, and then what it takes to get them there. That might be a workshop you put together with our expert team, or a conversation between the client's executives and our CEO that you set up. Your team gives you templates and material to start from, and the approach for each account is yours, because you know that customer better than anyone. That is also the part AI cannot do for you, though it will let you do it for more customers than you could alone. title: (Senior) Software Engineer - Data Integration Focus - Remote (m/f/d)
description:
At praxipal, we are building an AI-powered healthcare admin workforce to address the global shortage of medical staff.

Medical assistants are too valuable to spend their days chasing callbacks, cleaning up schedules, sending repetitive messages, or wrestling with invoicing and documentation workflows. Staff should spend time on patients. That’s why we build Luna.

Our AI receptionist, Luna, answers and automates phone calls and she’s loved by hundreds of medical practitioners. Right now, we’re expanding her from calls to end-to-end patient communication across any channel. Over the next years, we’ll grow her into an AI worker that automates all administrative processes in medical practices, embedded directly into the systems practice teams already use.

We’re backed by one of Europe’s leading investors and are one of the fastest growing healthtech startups in Germany. Our team has previously worked and studied at Palantir, Amazon, SAP, the University of Cambridge, and Hasso Plattner Institute.

We're hiring a (Senior) Software Engineer to help us scale Luna from hundreds of medical practitioners to hundreds of thousands.

 

The role

Integration is the bottleneck and the unlock: Luna can only automate workflows when she can reliably read and write the source of truth inside a practice: schedules, patient context, messages, statuses, and workflow metadata. That data lives in practice management systems (PMS) and related tools.

You’ll work hands-on, shipping production integrations. As the integration surface grows, you’ll shape the architecture, standards, and processes that keep integration work scalable.

title: Microwave Design Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • Work on a civilisation-scale problem - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire in Finance, People, or Legal directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator.

  • Grow as fast as the company does - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead.

  • Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersection

title: Senior AI Engineer, Location AI

More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. You'll be hired into one specific team or product area, but you'll work across teams where your expertise meets the highest-priority AI problems. title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-Doctoral Position Ferroelectric-Based Ternary Computing: From Circuit Design to System-Level Integration Scientific Context
description:
Energy efficiency remains one of the foremost challenges in modern computing, spanning from edge IoT devices to high-performance data centers. Conventional CMOS-based architectures are approaching fundamental physical limits, while the "memory wall" — data transfers between processor and memory accounting for 70 to 90% of total system energy — continues to worsen with the ever-growing demands of data-intensive workloads such as deep neural networks and signal processing pipelines.

In-Memory Computing (IMC) has emerged as a disruptive paradigm to overcome these bottlenecks by embedding arithmetic operations directly within memory arrays, drastically reducing data movement. In this landscape, ferroelectric field-effect transistors (FeFETs) stand out as particularly compelling devices: fully compatible with standard CMOS fabrication processes, non-volatile, reconfigurable, and capable of storing intermediate polarization states — a property that naturally enables ternary logic within a single device.

The Post-Doctoral position will cover at least one of the following tasks:

  • Design Standard Cell Technology Library based on FeFET devices developed at INL in order to be used with synthesis flow.

  • Design and optimize ternary arithmetic units (multiply-accumulate units, adders, comparators) based on the FeFET ternary gate library developed within the project, targeting area, power, and timing closure under realistic process constraints.
